https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: The United States on Saturday called for international cooperation to combat North Korea's illicit cyber activities following a massive cryptocurrency theft involving Binance. "Particularly in light of the recent hack of Binance, it is critical for governments to work together and do their own part to mitigate the DPRK cyber threat and curb illicit DPRK revenue generation," a State Department spokesperson told Yonhap News Agency in a written response.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 美国星期六呼吁加强国际合作，打击朝鲜的非法网络活动，此前发生了涉及Binance的大规模加密货币盗窃案。美国国务院发言人在书面回复中告诉韩联社：“尤其考虑到Binance近期遭黑客攻击，各国政府必须携手合作，尽到各自责任，减轻朝鲜带来的网络威胁，并切断朝鲜的非法收入来源。”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: The United States on Saturday called for international cooperation to combat North Korea's illicit cyber activities following a massive cryptocurrency theft involving Binance. "Particularly in light of the recent hack of Binance, it is critical for governments to work together and do their own part to mitigate the DPRK cyber threat and curb illicit DPRK revenue generation," a State Department spokesperson told Yonhap News Agency in a written response. DPRK stands for the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, North Korea's official name. The remarks were made in response to an inquiry about potential coordination between Washington and Seoul on additional sanctions following the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation's attribution of the cryptocurrency theft to North Korean actors. The spokesperson also emphasized the importance of enforcing existing international sanctions and taking measures to prevent Pyongyang from financing its weapons programs. "We expect all U.N. member states to enforce existing sanctions and take proactive measures to prevent the DPRK from funding its unlawful WMD and ballistic missile programs," the spokesperson said. "Coordinated unilateral sanctions continue to be a strong tool to prevent the flow of money that supports the proliferation of weapons," the spokesperson added. The remarks came after a South Korean unification ministry official said Thursday that Seoul had not yet begun discussing sanctions over the incident because the circumstances surrounding the theft had not been fully established. South Korea's foreign ministry separately said it was internally reviewing possible additional measures, including unilateral cyber sanctions, but that no decision had been made. The State Department did not directly address whether Washington had shared investigative findings with Seoul or held bilateral discussions on additional sanctions in connection with the incident
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: Binance遭黑客攻击后，美国呼吁协调应对朝鲜网络威胁
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 美国周六呼吁开展国际合作，打击朝鲜的非法网络活动。此前，Binance遭遇大规模加密货币盗窃案。美国国务院发言人在书面回复韩联社时表示：“尤其考虑到近期Binance被盗事件，各国政府必须加强合作，各尽其责，减轻朝鲜网络威胁，并切断朝鲜非法收入来源。”DPRK是朝鲜的正式名称“朝鲜民主主义人民共和国”。这番表态是在回应有关华盛顿与首尔可能协调追加制裁的问题。此前，美国联邦调查局将该起加密货币盗窃案归咎于朝鲜方面。该发言人还强调，执行现有国际制裁以及采取措施阻止平壤资助其武器计划至关重要。发言人说：“我们期望所有联合国会员国执行现有制裁，并采取主动措施，防止朝鲜为其非法的大规模杀伤性武器和弹道导弹计划提供资金。”发言人补充道：“协调一致的单边制裁仍是阻止资金流向支持武器扩散势力的有力工具。”此前，韩国统一部官员周四表示，由于围绕这起盗窃案的有关情况尚未完全查明，首尔尚未开始讨论针对此事的制裁。韩国外交部则单独表示，正在内部审查可能采取的追加措施，包括单边网络制裁，但尚未作出决定。美国国务院没有直接回应华盛顿是否与首尔共享了调查结论，或双方是否就与此案有关的追加制裁举行了双边讨论

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Helped by the artificial intelligence-led (AI) chip supercycle, Samsung Electronics is poised to become the first Korean company with cash assets of over 200 trillion won ($146.6 billion), industry data showed Sunday. Cash and cash equivalents at the chip giant are estimated to have reached 214.8 trillion won as of the third quarter, up 24.8 trillion won from 190 trillion won recorded three months earlier, according to the data. The amount is also nearly double from the 108.5 trillion won recorded at the end of the third quarter of 2025. Total assets owned by the company reached 791.8 trillion won as of end-September, up 32.4 trillion won from three months earlier. Market watchers estimate Samsung's current cash assets are enough to fully fund the top-line payout in its landmark shareholder return policy announced in August. The chip behemoth said about 90 trillion won to 110 trillion won will be available for shareholder returns in 2026. Investments into chipmaking infrastructure and research and development are expected to reach a historic high of over 100 trillion won this year, too, with 84.4 trillion won to be spent in expanding its memory production facilities. Samsung said it expects the semiconductor supercycle to continue through next year amid sustained investments in AI and a memory supply crunch while adding it plans to announce its shareholder policy for the coming year at a board meeting scheduled for January
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 数据显示，Samsung Electronics将成为首家现金资产超过1466亿美元的本国企业
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 行业数据显示，在人工智能芯片超级周期的推动下，Samsung Electronics即将成为首家现金资产超过200万亿韩元（1466亿美元）的韩国企业。数据显示，截至第三季度，这家芯片巨头的现金及现金等价物估计已达214.8万亿韩元，比三个月前记录的190万亿韩元增加24.8万亿韩元。这一金额也接近2025年第三季度末108.5万亿韩元的两倍。截至9月底，该公司拥有的总资产达到791.8万亿韩元，比三个月前增加32.4万亿韩元。市场观察人士估计，Samsung目前的现金资产足以全额支付其8月宣布的里程碑式股东回报政策中的顶层分红。这家芯片巨头表示，2026年将可用于股东回报的资金约为90万亿韩元至110万亿韩元。今年，公司在芯片制造基础设施以及研发方面的投资预计也将创下超过100万亿韩元的历史新高，其中将投入84.4万亿韩元扩建存储芯片生产设施。Samsung表示，在持续投资人工智能以及存储芯片供应紧张的情况下，预计半导体超级周期将延续至明年，同时公司计划在定于1月举行的董事会上公布下一年度的股东政策

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.summary_zh: 入学人数减少预示未来劳动者负担加重。随着人口老龄化和出生率持续低迷重塑韩国经济，韩国到2048年的总人口抚养比将升至经合组织成员国最高水平，而今年这一比率却是最低。根据经合组织最新人口预测计算，该比率将从今年的45.4%升至2048年的90.2%，超过希腊的90.1%。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body: Shrinking school intake signals heavier burden on future workers Korea is on course to have the highest total dependency ratio among OECD members by 2048, up from the lowest this year, as population aging and persistently low birthrates reshape the country's economy. Calculations based on the OECD’s latest population projections showed Sunday that the ratio will rise from 45.4 this year to 90.2 in 2048, exceeding Greece’s 90.1. It is forecast to reach 117.3 by 2070, roughly 2.6 times its current level. The indicator counts children aged 14 and younger and adults aged 65 and older for every 100 people aged 15 to 64. It reflects the population’s age structure rather than actual financial obligations or employment levels. Almost all of the projected increase stems from the expanding elderly population. The number of people aged 65 and older per 100 working-age people is expected to climb from 31.3 this year to 103.3 in 2070. The corresponding figure for children will stay near 14. Korea’s old-age dependency ratio currently ranks as the 18th-lowest among the OECD’s 38 members. By 2045, it is projected to reach 68.4, overtaking Japan’s 67.6 to become the highest. Its increase through 2070 will also be the steepest in the group. The government forecasts mandatory expenditure on programs for older people, including the basic pension and long-term care insurance, to grow 28.7 percent from 25.7 trillion won ($19 billion) this year to 33.1 trillion won in 2030. Mandatory welfare spending, which includes public pensions, is expected to increase 30.8 percent to 256.7 trillion won over the same period. The National Assembly Budget Office projects a higher total of 273.8 trillion won, exceeding the government’s estimate by more than 17 trillion won. The economic consequences will also depend on how many people remain employed and earn income. Extending working lives beyond 65 could help sustain tax revenue and social insurance contributions. In an April 2025 report, the Bank of Korea stressed the need to make greater use of older workers to cushion the decline in labor supply and slowdown in potential growth. The effects of falling births are already visible in schools. Next year’s elementary school intake is expected to drop below 300,000 for the first time since records began in 1964. Most of that cohort were born in 2020 and will turn 30 in 2050, building their careers while facing a growing burden of supporting older generations, including those born before 1980. Minister of Planning and Budget Park Hong-geun described demographic change as “a matter of survival” and called for reforms across education, employment and welfare to sustain economic vitality as the workforce shrinks. He also stressed the need to ease families’ child care burdens and help older people remain active in society. “We must use advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence to address population shortfalls and adapt immigration policy to reflect practical realities,” he said at a seminar on Oct. 29
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.title_zh: 韩国人口抚养比将由经合组织最低水平升至最高水平，预计时间为2048年
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body_zh: 入学人口减少预示未来劳动者负担加重：到2048年，韩国总抚养比预计将在经济合作与发展组织成员国中居首，而今年这一比率却是最低。人口老龄化持续低生育率正在重塑该国经济。韩国经济合作与发展组织最新人口预测的相关计算显示，这一比率将从今年的45.4升至2048年的90.2，超过希腊的90.1。预计到2070年将升至117.3，约为当前水平的2.6倍。该指标统计每100名15至64岁人口对应的14岁及以下儿童和65岁及以上成年人数量，反映的是人口年龄结构，而非实际财务负担或就业水平。预计增幅几乎全部来自不断扩大的老年人口。每100名劳动年龄人口对应的65岁及以上人口，预计将从今年的31.3升至2070年的103.3，儿童对应的相应数字则将维持在14左右。目前，韩国的老年抚养比在韩国经济合作与发展组织38个成员国中排名第18低。到2045年，预计将升至68.4，超过日本的67.6并成为最高。到2070年，其增幅也将是成员国中最陡峭的。韩国政府预计，包括基本养老金和长期护理保险在内的老年人项目法定支出，将从今年的25.7万亿韩元（190亿美元）增长28.7%，至2030年达到33.1万亿韩元。同期，包括公共养老金在内的法定福利支出预计将增长30.8%，达到256.7万亿韩元。韩国国会预算处预计总额将增至273.8万亿韩元，比韩国政府的估算高出逾17万亿韩元。经济后果还将取决于有多少人能够继续就业并获得收入。延长65岁以后的工作年限，有助于维持税收收入和社会保险缴款。韩国银行在2025年4月的一份报告中强调，应更加充分地利用年长劳动者，以缓解劳动力供给下降和潜在增长放缓的影响。出生率下降的影响已在学校显现。明年小学入学人数预计将降至30万人以下，这是自1964年开始记录以来首次。其中大多数孩子出生于2020年，到2050年将年满30岁；他们在建立职业生涯的同时，还将面临日益沉重的赡养年长一代的负担，其中包括1980年以前出生的人。韩国企划预算部长朴弘埈将人口结构变化形容为“关乎生存的问题”，并呼吁改革教育、就业和福利政策，以在劳动力规模缩小时维持经济活力。他还强调，应减轻家庭的育儿负担，并帮助老年人继续积极参与社会。“我们必须利用人工智能等先进技术，应对人口不足，并使移民政策适应实际情况。”他在10月29日举行的一场研讨会上说……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title: Tim Hortons, a letter to my father
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: Having a whole business plan from Canada to succeed in Korea might seem simple, but it must have taken years of dedication for Korea to have so many Tim Hortons today. The Tim Hortons here are so different from what I was used to back in Canada, yet they still feel the same. Tim Hortons makes me think of my father, because he always wanted to stop there, and because deep down I always wanted to stop too, even if I never said anything.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 从加拿大来到韩国发展事业，听起来或许很简单，但韩国如今拥有这么多Tim Hortons surely意味着多年的悉心经营。这里的Tim Hortons与我过去在加拿大习惯的很不相同，却依然让我感到熟悉。Tim Hortons让我想起父亲，因为他总是想在那里停一停，而我也一直想进去坐坐，哪怕从未说出口。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: Having a whole business plan from Canada to succeed in Korea might seem simple, but it must have taken years of dedication for Korea to have so many Tim Hortons today. The Tim Hortons here are so different from what I was used to back in Canada, yet they still feel the same. They are different because in Canada it was always only about the simplicity of grabbing a coffee and a sandwich on the go with my family when starting the day or on a road trip somewhere in Quebec or elsewhere in Canada. In Korea, Tim Hortons is a whole experience, from the decor to the very rich menu, helping Koreans feel as though they are visiting Canada for a brief moment. They say the most indifferent people live abroad and the ones with the big hearts will stay close to their families. My problem is that I have the biggest heart but a head full of dreams. I found myself, more times than I should, feeling homesick and sad that I have left my parents behind back in Quebec City. Tim Hortons here has reminded me of that more than anything else, not because it is deeply connected to Quebec culture, but because it was a place I would go all the time with my family. From my father’s daily coffee stops, to all the summer days we grabbed iced cappuccinos on the go to enjoy outside together at home, to all the family trips we took during which we enjoyed coffee time together. Tim Hortons makes me think of my father, because he always wanted to stop there, and because deep down I always wanted to stop too, even if I never said anything. So it always made me happy when he pulled into a Tim Hortons parking lot. Every time I walk by a Tim Hortons in the streets of Seoul, I am reminded of the time I spent with my family as a child. I am reminded of the life I have left behind back home and of the most precious and memorable childhood I had with my family, especially with my father. For me, Tim Hortons carries all my childhood memories with my family, and it surely always will. At 30 years old, I discovered that a dish can carry so many memories that just eating it could make you instantly cry. Somehow, Tim Hortons has found its way back to me since it arrived in Korea. It reminded me to call my parents and tell them how much I love them, and to book that flight to Quebec for the winter. And this is the perk of living abroad. Karel Kym is a master’s student in International Peace and Security at Korea University and a recipient of the Global Korea Scholarship. Originally from Quebec City, she is also the founder of Québec2Korea, a project dedicated to exploring and sharing the people-to-people connections between Quebec and Korea
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: Tim Hortons，写给我父亲的一封信
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 拥有一整套源自加拿大、旨在韩国取得成功的商业计划，或许看起来很简单，但韩国如今拥有这么多家Tim Hortons，背后必然凝聚了多年的努力。这里的Tim Hortons与我过去在加拿大习惯的很不相同，却又让我感到无比熟悉。之所以不同，是因为在加拿大，我总是只把它当作一个简单的地方：一天开始时，或去魁北克及加拿大其他地区自驾途中，和家人顺手买一杯咖啡和一份三明治。在韩国，Tim Hortons是一段完整的体验，从店内装潢到非常丰富的菜单，都让韩国人仿佛在一瞬间置身于加拿大。人们常说，最冷淡的人选择在国外生活，而胸襟宽广的人会留在家人身边。我的问题是，我拥有一颗最宽广的心，脑海中却装满了梦想。不知多少次，我感到想家，也因把父母留在魁北克城而难过。这里的Tim Hortons比其他任何东西都更能唤起这种感受，不是因为它与魁北克文化有着深厚的联系，而是因为那是我过去经常和家人一起去的地方。从父亲每天喝咖啡时停靠的地方，到我们全家在家附近的户外一起享用冰卡布奇诺的夏日时光，再到我们共同出行的每一次家庭旅行，一家人共享咖啡时光。Tim Hortons让我想起父亲，因为他总是想在那里停一停，而在我内心深处，我也一直想停下来，哪怕从未说出口。因此，每当他把车开进Tim Hortons的停车场，我都会感到快乐。如今，每当走过首尔街头的Tim Hortons，我都会想起自己小时候与家人共度的时光，想起被我留在故乡的那段生活，也想起与家人、尤其是与父亲共同拥有的最珍贵、最难忘的童年。对我而言，Tim Hortonics承载着我与家人有关的全部童年记忆，而且今后也一定会继续如此。30岁时，我意识到，一道食物可以承载如此多的记忆，仅仅吃上一口，就可能让你瞬间落泪。自从Tim Hortons来到韩国后，它不知怎的又重新找到了我，提醒我给父母打电话，告诉他们我有多爱他们，也提醒我订下去往魁北克过冬的机票。这正是海外生活的一大好处。Karel Kym是韩国大学国际和平与安全专业的硕士生，也是Global Korea Scholarship奖学金获得者。她来自魁北克城，还是Québec2Korea项目的发起人；该项目致力于探索并分享魁北克与韩国之间的民间联系

Expressing gratitude for the service and sacrifice of Belgian troops, Lim said the Korean government would work closely with Belgium to translate the outcomes of the June summit into tangible benefits for the people and businesses of both countries.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 在纪念比利时军队参加1950至1953年朝鲜战争75周年之际，Jans强调了两国共同的历史、友谊与团结，这些因素至今仍将两国联系在一起。Lim对比利时军队的服役与牺牲表示感谢，并表示韩国政府将与比利时密切合作，把6月峰会的成果转化为两国人民和企业切实可享的益处。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Belgian Ambassador to Korea Bruno Jans, left, raises a toast with Theodora Gentzis, center, secretary-general of Belgium's foreign affairs ministry, and Lim Sang-woo, Korea's deputy minister for public diplomacy, during a reception marking Belgium's King's Day and the 125th anniversary of diplomatic relations between Belgium and Korea in Seoul, Thursday. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The government is reportedly reviewing plans to expand the label-free mandate for domestically produced drinking water to include bottled water brands imported from overseas, officials said Sunday. The plan was discussed in a recent meeting with importers of foreign-produced bottled water, according to the officials from the environment ministry. The meeting was a routine consultation with industry officials, and the ministry is still undecided on whether to apply the mandate to offshore brands, they added. Korea has required all bottled water produced and sold domestically to be label-free starting early this year, replacing physical labels with QR codes on bottle caps and external packaging. The mandate is expected to reduce the country's annual plastic usage by 2,270 metric tons, according to the ministry of climate, energy and environment. Bottled water produced overseas, however, is excluded from the mandate and is sold with traditional labels. Domestic producers have raised equity concerns, arguing that competing products in the same market should be subject to the same standards. As of September 2024, there were 63 drinking water producers in Korea, along with 107 importers of bottled water. The domestic market for bottled water has grown by an annual average of 7.6 percent since 2019, reaching $4.3 billion in 2024, according to data from Samil PwC Business Research, a local consulting agency
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 韩国审查将免标签要求扩大至外国生产的瓶装水的计划

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.summary: Driven by expanded direct flights, cruise traffic, and a surge in international visitors, Busan welcomed 3.93 million foreign tourists in the first nine months of 2026, the Busan Metropolitan Government said Friday. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.summary_zh: 釜山 metropolitan government周五表示，得益于直飞航线增加、邮轮客流增长以及国际访客激增，釜山在2026年前九个月接待了393万名外国游客。这一数字轻松超过了这座东南港口城市2025年全年364万人的游客总量，使其有望大幅提前完成每年接待400万名游客的目标。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.body: Long viewed as a scenic coastal secondary stop for international travelers venturing outside Seoul, Korea’s second-largest city is rapidly transforming into a standalone global destination. Driven by expanded direct flights, cruise traffic, and a surge in international visitors, Busan welcomed 3.93 million foreign tourists in the first nine months of 2026, the Busan Metropolitan Government said Friday. The figure easily surpassed the southeastern port city's total visitor count of 3.64 million for all of 2025 and positions it to clear its annual target of 4 million visitors well ahead of schedule. The shift marks a crucial milestone in Korea’s broader efforts to disperse tourism beyond the capital. Nationwide, international arrivals rose 21.5 percent over the same period, but Busan saw a 47 percent surge — more than double the national growth rate. Unlike past years, when foreign tourists typically entered Korea through Incheon International Airport before taking high-speed trains south, travelers are increasingly bypassing Seoul altogether. Nearly 63 percent of foreign visitors to Busan in September arrived directly through Gimhae International Airport or the Port of Busan, up from 50.4 percent in January. The port saw a record 96,493 direct arrivals in September alone — a nearly 150 percent increase from the previous year — supported by a postpandemic revival in regional cruise itineraries. Meanwhile, direct arrivals through Gimhae International Airport climbed 48.1 percent to 218,049. The booming headcounts have brought an economic windfall to local businesses. Foreign credit card spending in Busan topped 1.01 trillion won ($750 million) through September, a 51.9 percent increase from a year ago. Outside of Seoul, which logged 8.84 trillion won, Busan is the only metropolitan area in Korea to break the 1 trillion won threshold in international tourism spending, accounting for more than half of all credit card expenditures by international visitors outside of the capital. Local officials attribute the momentum to market diversification. While visitor arrivals from traditional East Asian markets dipped slightly at the end of summer, sharp gains in Western markets filled the gap. American travelers to Busan surged 77.2 percent through September to reach 324,816, while French visitor numbers doubled to 43,165. Australian arrivals rose nearly 48 percent. Western media outlets and travel platforms have increasingly highlighted the port city's mix of urban infrastructure and coastal topography. Expedia ranked Busan fifth globally in search growth for upcoming travel destinations, while Airbnb reported a 30 percent year-on-year increase in property searches across the city. City officials plan to leverage the momentum to expand regional tourism infrastructure across neighboring southern provinces. "Global travelers are no longer just stopping by Busan — they are flying directly to us as their primary destination," Mayor Chun Jae-soo said. "We will focus our resources on improving the quality of our tourism infrastructure so these visitors stay longer and return." https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.title_zh: 釜山在9个月内超越2025年全年水平，外国游客逼近400万人次
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.body_zh: 长期以来，韩国第二大城市釜山一直被视为国际游客前往首尔以外地区旅行时沿途停留的海滨支线目的地，但如今正迅速转型为一个独立的全球旅游目的地。釜山广域市政府周五表示，得益于新增直飞航班、邮轮客流以及国际访客激增，2026年前九个月共接待外国游客393万人次。这一数字轻松超过了这座东南部港口城市2025年全年364万人次的游客总量，使其有望大幅提前完成年度接待400万名游客的目标。这一转变标志着韩国推动旅游客流从首都分流至其他地区的更大努力取得了一个关键里程碑。同期，全国国际游客抵达量增长21.5%，而釜山增幅达47%，超过全国增速的两倍。与以往外国游客通常先经仁川国际机场入境韩国、再乘高速列车南下不同，如今越来越多游客直接绕过首尔。9月抵达釜山的外国游客中，近63%直接经金海国际机场或釜山港入境，高于1月的50.4%。仅9月份，釜山港就录得96,493人次直接入境，创下历史新高，较上年增长近150%，这得益于疫情后区域邮轮航线复苏。与此同时，经金海国际机场直接抵达的人次增长48.1%，达到218,049人次。游客数量激增为当地商家带来丰厚收益。截至9月，外国游客在釜山的信用卡消费额突破1.01万亿韩元（7.5亿美元），同比增长51.9%。在消费额达到8.84万亿韩元的首尔之外，釜山是韩国唯一突破1万亿韩元国际旅游消费门槛的大都市区，占首尔以外国际游客全部信用卡消费支出的半数以上。地方官员将这一增长势头归因于市场多元化。虽然夏末来自东亚传统市场的访客人数略有下降，但西方市场的大幅增长填补了缺口。截至9月，美国游客赴釜山人数增长77.2%，达到324,816人次；法国游客人数翻倍，达到43,165人次；澳大利亚游客人数增长近48%。西方媒体和旅游平台日益关注这座港口城市融合城市基础设施与海岸地貌的特色。Expedia将釜山列为全球旅行目的地搜索增幅第五名，Airbnb则报告称，全城房源搜索量同比增长30%。市政府计划利用这一势头，在周边南部各州扩大区域旅游基础设施。市长全在秀表示：“全球游客不再只是途经釜山——他们正直接飞往我们这里，把釜山作为主要目的地。我们将集中资源提升旅游基础设施质量，让这些游客停留更久并再次到访。”本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 全新改款车型带来扎实稳定的车身和精致舒适的乘坐体验。全新奥迪A6旗舰轿车让人印象最深的是其稳健扎实的行驶质感，在灵敏操控与长途舒适性之间实现平衡。经过七年等待，这款德国汽车制造商的旗舰燃油轿车以更明确的目标感回归，定位介于BMW的灵活敏捷与Mercedes-Benz对乘坐舒适性的重视之间。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Full redesign model brings firm ride, refined comfort The new Audi A6 flagship sedan makes its strongest impression through a firm, planted ride that balances sharp handling with long-distance comfort. After a seven-year wait for a full redesign, the German automaker’s flagship combustion-engine sedan returns with a clearer sense of purpose, positioning itself between BMW’s agility and Mercedes-Benz’s emphasis on ride comfort. Driving the A6 45 TFSI quattro S-line across Seoul’s urban streets and surrounding highways over three days, covering about 300 kilometers, the sedan felt more than composed and reassuring at speed without sacrificing everyday usability. The first thing that stood out was how firmly the car held the road. Its suspension absorbed bumps without allowing the body to feel loose or unsettled, while steering inputs translated into predictable movements. The ride was noticeably taut, giving the sedan a sporting character without making it excessively harsh. Rather than chasing the razor-sharp responsiveness associated with BMW or the softer isolation favored by Mercedes-Benz, Audi has found a middle ground that should appeal to drivers seeking both engagement and comfort. The A6’s maneuverability is another strength. Rear-wheel steering helps the large sedan feel more nimble in tight urban streets while improving stability at higher speeds. The result is a car that feels more manageable than its size suggests, particularly when navigating narrow roads or changing lanes on the highway. Refinement remains central to the package. At around 100 kilometers per hour, wind and road noise stayed well contained, leaving the cabin calm enough for relaxed conversation. Audi says the redesigned model’s noise insulation has improved by as much as 30 percent over its predecessor. That quietness also reflects aerodynamic improvements. The new A6 has a drag coefficient as low as 0.23, the lowest among Audi’s production combustion-engine models. Redesigned air curtains around the front bumper and underbody panels help smooth airflow, reducing both drag and wind noise. The test vehicle pairs a 2.0-liter turbocharged gasoline engine with a seven-speed S tronic transmission, producing 271.9 horsepower. The redesigned A6 has already gained traction in Korea. It reached 1,752 sales through August after starting its delivery in April, contributing to a 22 percent year-on-year increase in the brand’s sales to 9,082 vehicles over the first eight months combined this year
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 【试驾】奥迪韩国A6回归，定位动感运动型轿车
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 全面改款带来扎实行驶质感与精致舒适性 全新奥迪A6旗舰轿车最具亮点的，是稳固扎实的行驶表现，在精准操控与长途舒适性之间取得平衡。经过七年的等待，这款德国汽车制造商的旗舰内燃机轿车以更明确的产品定位回归市场， positioning 自己于BMW的灵活敏捷与Mercedes-Benz对乘坐舒适性的重视之间。连续3天驾驶A6 45 TFSI quattro S-line穿行于首尔城市街道及周边高速公路，行驶约300公里后，这款轿车在高速状态下展现出沉稳与安心感，同时没有牺牲日常实用性。最突出的感受，是车辆牢牢贴合路面。其悬架过滤颠簸时不会让车身显得松散或不稳，转向输入也能转化为可预期的行驶动作。乘坐感受明显更紧致，赋予这款轿车运动特质，同时又不会显得过于生硬。奥迪没有追求BMW式的 razor-sharp 响应，也没有采用Mercedes-Benz偏爱的柔和隔绝感，而是找到了兼顾驾驶参与感与舒适性的中间路线，对希望两者兼得的驾驶者颇具吸引力。A6的机动性是另一项优势。后轮转向让这款大型轿车在狭窄城市街道上更加灵活，同时提升了高速稳定性。由此带来的效果是，尽管车身庞大，驾驶感受却比尺寸所暗示的更易于掌控，尤其是在狭窄道路上行驶或于高速公路变道时。精致感仍是整款车的核心。车速约为每小时100公里时，风噪和路噪均得到良好控制，车厢内安静得足以让人轻松交谈。奥迪表示，改款车型的隔音性能较前代最多提升30 percent。这种静谧感也得益于空气动力学优化。新款A6的阻力系数低至0.23，是奥迪量产内燃机车型中最低的水平。前保险杠周围重新设计的导流帘以及底盘空气导流板有助于梳理气流，降低风阻和风噪。测试车辆搭载2.0升涡轮增压汽油发动机和7速S tronic变速箱，最大输出271.9 horsepower。改款A6在韩国市场已初步赢得认可。该车型4月开始交付后，截至8月底累计售出1,752辆，推动该品牌今年前八个月合计销量同比增长22 percent，达到9,082辆

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 고일환 기자 = 올해 미국 중간선거에서 나타난 민주당의 압승은 100여년 만에 두 번째로 높은 투표율의 영향 때문이라는 분석이 제기됐다. 7일(현지시간) 워싱턴포스트(WP)에 따르면 플로리다대 선거연구소의 잠정 집계 결과 이번 중간선거에는 투표 자격을 가진 미국인의 49%가 참여했다. 1914년 이후 가장 높았던 2018년 중간선거의 투표율 50%에는 미치지 못하지만, 두 번째로 높은 투표율 기록이다. 또한 애리조나에서는 민주당이 60년 만에 주지사와 주 상·하원을 모두 장악하는 등 전국적으로 민주당 후보들이 강세를 보였다. 전문가들은 트럼프 대통령이 지지층뿐 아니라 반대층의 투표 참여까지 자극한 것이 높은 투표율의 배경이라고 분석했다. 민주당 정치 전략가 출신 톰 보니어는 "투표율에 관한 한 트럼프는 지난 100년간 누구보다 큰 영향을 미쳤다"며 "지지하는 쪽과 반대하는 쪽을 모두 투표장으로 끌어내는 능력이 있다"고 말했다. 다만 이번에는 일부 공화당 유권자들이 트럼프 대통령에게 등을 돌리면서 투표를 포기한 것으로 보인다고 그는 분석했다. 공화당 여론조사 전문가인 대런 쇼 텍사스대 교수도 높은 투표율이 당초 예상과 달리 민주당에 유리하게 작용했다고 평가했다. 쇼 교수는 경제에 대한 불만과 이란전쟁, 전쟁에 따른 휘발유 가격 상승 등에 불만을 가진 평소 투표 참여도가 낮은 유권자들이 대거 투표장에 나온 것으로 분석했다. 그는 "트럼프는 놀라운 동원력을 가진 인물"이라면서도 "동시에 역사상 가장 강력한 역동원 효과를 일으키는 인물 가운데 하나"라고 말했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/08 14:34 송고 2026년11월08일 14시34분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.title_zh: 美国中期选举投票率为49%……“投票热情推动民主党取得压倒性胜利”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者高铉焕 = 有分析认为，今年美国中期选举中民主党取得压倒性胜利，是因为投票率达到100多年来的第二高水平。据《华盛顿邮报》（WP）7日报道（当地时间），佛罗里达大学选举研究所的初步统计显示，本次中期选举共有49%的有投票资格美国人参与投票。虽然未达到1914年以来最高的2018年中期选举50%的投票率，但仍创下第二高的投票率纪录。此外，在亚利桑那州，民主党60年来首次同时拿下州长以及州参众两院职位，民主党候选人在全国各地均表现强劲。专家分析称，高投票率的背景在于特朗普总统不仅促使支持者，也刺激了反对者参与投票。民主党政治战略家汤姆·博尼表示：“就投票率而言，特朗普过去100年来的影响无人能及。他有能力把支持者和反对者都吸引到投票站。”不过，他分析称，此次部分共和党选民因背离特朗普总统而放弃投票。共和党民调专家、德克萨斯大学 教授达伦·肖也评价称，高投票率出乎原先预料，最终有利于民主党。肖教授分析称，许多平时投票参与率较低的选民因对经济的不满、伊朗战争以及战争引发的汽油价格上涨等不满，纷纷前往投票站。他说：“特朗普具有非凡的动员能力”，但同时也是“历史上产生最强烈反向动员效果的人物之一”。报道可通过KakaoTalk的 okjebo 查阅。〈版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再发布及用于人工智能学习和应用〉2026/11/08 14:34发布 2026年11月8日14时34分发布

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.title: 이용철 법무후보, 野 '숨은 설계자' 공세에 "대장동 알지 못해"
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 이승연 기자 = 신임 법무부 장관 후보자로 지명된 이용철 방위사업청장이 대장동 개발 비리에 연루됐다는 의혹에 반박하고 나섰다. 이 후보자는 2010년 유동규 씨가 전 성남시 시설관리공단 기획본부장으로 임용될 당시 임원추천위원으로, 유씨에게 유독 높은 점수를 줬다는 의혹을 받고 있다. 이 후보자는 "추천 위원 5명이 상대평가를 하는 방식이었는데 5명 모두가 유씨에게 높은 점수를 줬다"며 "제가 다른 위원보다 조금 더 점수를 많이 줬다는 게 의혹의 취지인데 정량적 평가가 아닌 정성적 평가에서는 그런 편차가 있을 수 있지 않겠느냐"고 했다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.summary_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）李承妍记者＝被提名为新任法务部长候选人的防卫事业厅厅长柳 용철反驳了涉入大长洞开发舞弊事件的嫌疑。据称，2010年柳成规出任原城南市设施管理公团企划本部长时，柳 용철担任高管推荐委员，并因给予柳成规异常高的分数而受到质疑。这名候选人说：“推荐方式是由5名委员进行相互评价，而5人都给了柳成规较高的分数。所谓我给其他委员的分数略高，正是这一嫌疑的核心，但在非定量评价而是定性评价的情况下，难道不会存在这种程度的差异吗？”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 이승연 기자 = 신임 법무부 장관 후보자로 지명된 이용철 방위사업청장이 대장동 개발 비리에 연루됐다는 의혹에 반박하고 나섰다. 이 후보자는 2010년 유동규 씨가 전 성남시 시설관리공단 기획본부장으로 임용될 당시 임원추천위원으로, 유씨에게 유독 높은 점수를 줬다는 의혹을 받고 있다. 이 후보자는 "추천 위원 5명이 상대평가를 하는 방식이었는데 5명 모두가 유씨에게 높은 점수를 줬다"며 "제가 다른 위원보다 조금 더 점수를 많이 줬다는 게 의혹의 취지인데 정량적 평가가 아닌 정성적 평가에서는 그런 편차가 있을 수 있지 않겠느냐"고 했다. 이어 "다른 위원들과 평가 방향이 달랐다면 비난 가능성이 있을지 모르지만 약간의 편차 자체가 문제가 될까 싶다"고 덧붙였다. 이 후보자는 추천위원으로 있었던 시점에는 유동규 씨가 대장동 사업에 관여할 것이란 사실을 알 수 없었다고 재차 의혹에 선을 그었다. 그는 "제가 만약 대장동의 숨은 설계자라면 2010년에 향후 일어날 대장동 사업에 관한 모든 내용이 제게 입력돼있어야 한다"고 했다. 유동규 씨는 2014년 성남도시개발공사 기획본부장을 맡았으며 이듬해 대장동 개발 사업이 본격화되면서 사업 전반을 지휘했던 것으로 알려졌다. 새 법무장관에 이용철 후보자를 지명한 것이 이재명 대통령의 공소취소를 위한 인사라는 지적에 대해서는 "정리된 다음 입장을 전할 예정"이라고 답했다. 한때 같은 법무법인에 속했던 것은 이 대통령이 성남시장 출마를 앞두고 개인 사무실을 접어야 해 진행 중인 사건의 후속 처리를 돕기 위해서였다고 설명했다. 그는 "도움을 드리고 싶어서 저희 법인에 들어오시라고 했고, 이후 시장에 당선이 돼 바로 탈퇴하셨다"며 "법무법인에 함께 있었던 기간은 3개월"이라고 부연했다. 비검찰 출신인 데에 따라 공소청 내부 사정에 밝지 못하고 법무 행정에 취약할 것이라는 지적에 대해서는 "관점의 차이"라고 반박했다. 이 후보자는 "장단점이 있을 것"이라며 "잘 알면 빠른 속도로 조직을 안착시키는 데에 도움이 될 수는 있겠지만 지나치게 내부자 시선으로 이뤄질 수 있다"고 했다. 이어 "새로운 형사사법 제도를 만들게 된 원인과 계기를 생각한다면 좀 더 외부자 시선에서 제도를 안착하는 것이 객관적·합리적일 수 있다"고 했다. 65대 법무부 장관인 박상기 전 장관을 언급하며 "변호사도 아닌 학자셨는데도 장관을 잘하셨다"며 "저는 그래도 변호사를 30년 했다"고 했다. 지난 6일 청와대는 이 후보자를 법무부 장관 후보자로 지명했다. 법무부 장관직은 정성호 전 장관이 물러난 올해 8월부터 70여일째 공석이다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/08 14:30 송고 2026년11월08일 14시30분 송고 (서울=연합뉴스) 원형민 기자 = 이재명 정부의 두 번째 법무부 장관 후보자로 이용철 현 방위사업청장이 지명됐다.circlemin@yna.co.kr
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.title_zh: 李在铁法律事务候选人针对野阵营“幕后策划者”的攻击表示：“我根本不知道大长洞”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者李承妍 = 被提名为新任法务部长官的防卫事业厅厅长李 용철挺身反驳涉入大长洞开发腐败案的嫌疑。2010年柳东奎被任命为城南市设施管理公团企划本部长时，李 용철担任理事推荐委员，因给柳东奎打了异常高的分数而受到质疑。该候选人表示：“当时是由5名推荐委员进行相对评价，5人都给了柳东奎较高的分数。我比其他委员打的分数略高，这是质疑的本意，但在非定量评价而是定性评价的情况下，难道不会存在这种程度上的差距吗？”他补充道：“如果我与其他委员的评价方向不同，可能会有受到指责的可能，但仅凭些许差距本身会成为问题吗？”该候选人再次划清界限，称自己担任推荐委员时不可能知道柳东奎日后会参与大长洞项目。他说：“如果我是大长洞的幕后设计者，那么2010年就必须把所有与日后将开展的大长洞项目有关的信息输入给我。”柳东奎曾于2014年担任城南城市开发公团企划本部长，据悉，次年大长洞开发项目全面启动后，他曾统筹整个项目。对于新任法务部长官提名人选李 용철被指是李在明总统为实现公职辞任而进行的人事安排，他答道：“整理妥当后，我会说明我的立场。”他解释说，李在明总统曾在参选城南市长前关闭个人事务所并加入同一律所，以便协助处理进行中的案件后续事宜。他说：“我们当时是希望总统能到我们律所任职，后来他当选市长后便立即退出。”并补充称：“他与本所在律所共处的时间为3个月。”针对其非检察官出身，不了解公职厅内部情况且在法务行政方面存在不足的指责，他反驳称：“这是视角上的差异。”该候选人表示：“这项工作有长处也有短处。善加运用或许有助于迅速稳定组织，但过度以内部人士的视角来推进也并非不可。”他接着说：“如果思考促使我们建立新的刑事司法制度的原因和契机，从更外部人士的视角推动制度落地，或许会更客观、合理。”提及65岁的前法务部长官朴相基时，他说：“他既不是律师，而是学者，却依然把部长官工作做得很好。”并称：“不过，我毕竟当了30年律师。”青瓦台6日提名该候选人为法务部长官人选。自前任法务部长官郑成浩今年8月辞职以来，法务部长官职位已空缺约70天。报道请通过KakaoTalk okjebo <版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载·再发布及用于人工智能训练和运用> 2026/11/08 14:30发稿 2026年11月08日14时30分发稿 （首尔=韩联社）记者元亨敏 = 李在明政府的第二名法务部长官候选人、现任防卫事业厅厅长李 용철获提名。circlemin@yna.co.kr

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.title: 美국방장관·인태사령관 방중하나…미중 군사교류 확대 주목
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.summary: (베이징=연합뉴스) 한종구 특파원 = 피트 헤그세스 미국 국방장관과 새뮤얼 퍼파로 미군 인도·태평양사령관이 조만간 중국을 방문할 가능성이 제기됐다. 8일 홍콩 사우스차이나모닝포스트(SCMP) 등에 따르면 스티븐 올린스 미중관계전국위원회(NCUSCR) 회장은 지난 6일 중국 하이난성 싼야에서 열린 '글로벌 해양협력·해양 거버넌스 포럼'에 화상으로 참석해 두 사람의 방중 가능성을 언급했다. 올린스 회장은 "헤그세스 장관과 퍼파로 사령관이 조만간 중국을 방문할 수 있는 것으로 알고 있다"며 "두 사람의 방문이 양국 군 당국 간 소통을 정례화하는 데 도움이 될 것"이라고 말했다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.summary_zh: （北京＝韩联社）汉钟求特派记者报道称，hegseth（赫格塞斯）美国国防部长和Samuel Paparo（塞缪尔·帕帕罗）美军印太司令部司令近期可能访问中国。据《南华早报》（SCMP）等媒体8日报道，Steven Hollins（史蒂文·霍林斯）美中关系全国委员会（NCUSCR）主席6日以视频方式出席在中国海南省三亚举行的“全球海洋合作与海洋治理论坛”，并提到了两人访华的可能性。霍林斯主席表示：“我知道赫格塞斯部长和帕帕罗司令近期可能会访问中国。两人此次访问将有助于将两国军方之间的沟通正规化。”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.body: (베이징=연합뉴스) 한종구 특파원 = 피트 헤그세스 미국 국방장관과 새뮤얼 퍼파로 미군 인도·태평양사령관이 조만간 중국을 방문할 가능성이 제기됐다. 8일 홍콩 사우스차이나모닝포스트(SCMP) 등에 따르면 스티븐 올린스 미중관계전국위원회(NCUSCR) 회장은 지난 6일 중국 하이난성 싼야에서 열린 '글로벌 해양협력·해양 거버넌스 포럼'에 화상으로 참석해 두 사람의 방중 가능성을 언급했다. 올린스 회장은 "헤그세스 장관과 퍼파로 사령관이 조만간 중국을 방문할 수 있는 것으로 알고 있다"며 "두 사람의 방문이 양국 군 당국 간 소통을 정례화하는 데 도움이 될 것"이라고 말했다. 그는 양국이 군사적 오판으로 인한 충돌을 방지하기 위해 모든 수준에서 군사 교류를 정례화하고, 충돌이 발생하더라도 신속한 소통으로 긴장을 완화할 수 있는 체계를 마련해야 한다고 촉구했다. SCMP는 소식통을 인용해 미중이 최근 몇 달간 헤그세스 장관의 중국 방문 문제를 논의했으며 연내 방문이 성사될 가능성이 있다고 전했다. 지난 9월 워싱턴에서 열린 미중 정상회담 이후 헤그세스 장관과 둥쥔 중국 국방부장의 상호 방문 가능성도 논의된 것으로 알려졌다. 다만 헤그세스 장관은 최근 미국 중간선거에서 공화당이 패배한 이후 탄핵 압박을 받고 있어 거취가 불투명한 상황이다. 공화당 일각에서도 이란 전쟁 수행 등을 문제 삼아 탄핵을 추진하고 민주당도 국방부 운영에 대한 조사를 준비하고 있어서다. 그러나 트럼프 대통령은 여전히 그에 대한 신임을 유지하고 있다. 또 퍼파로 사령관의 방중이 성사된다면 2015년 이후 약 11년 만에 미국의 태평양지역 최고 군사령관이 중국을 방문하게 된다. 중국 난징대 국제관계학원 주펑 원장은 SCMP에 퍼파로 사령관의 방중이 미중 양국 군 당국 간 실무급 소통을 강화하는 계기가 될 수 있다고 평가했다. 미 국방부에 따르면 양국 국방 당국자들은 지난 2∼3일 워싱턴에서 '위기 소통·예방 실무그룹' 연례회의를 열고 군사적 위험을 줄이기 위한 방안을 논의했다. 앞서 지난 8월에는 퍼파로 사령관이 캐나다에서 양즈빈 중국 인민해방군 동부전구 사령원과 만나 군사적 오판을 막기 위한 고위급 소통의 중요성을 논의했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/08 14:24 송고 2026년11월08일 14시24분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.title_zh: 美国国防部长和印太司令部司令将访问中国，美中军事交流扩大备受关注
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.body_zh: （北京＝韩联社）驻华记者韩宗求报道称，美国国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯与美军印太司令部司令塞缪尔·帕帕罗近期可能访华。据《南华早报》（SCMP）等媒体8日报道，中美关系全国委员会（NCUSCR）会长史蒂文·奥林斯于6日以视频方式出席在海南省三亚举行的“全球海洋合作·海洋治理论坛”，并提到上述两人可能访华。奥林斯会长表示：“据了解，赫格塞斯部长和帕帕罗司令近期可能访问中国。两人的访问将有助于推动两国军方当局之间的沟通机制化。”他还敦促两国在所有层级将军事交流机制化，以防止因军事误判而引发冲突，并建立即使发生冲突也能通过迅速沟通缓解紧张的体系。《南华早报》援引消息人士称，中美双方近几个月来讨论了赫格塞斯部长访华问题，并称其年内成行可能性较高。据报道，在华盛顿举行的中美领导人会谈后，双方曾讨论赫格塞斯部长与中国国防部长董军互访的可能性。不过，由于美国近期中期选举中共和党败选后，赫格塞斯部长面临弹劾压力，其行踪目前并不明朗。共和党内部也有人以对伊朗战争的处置等问题为由推动弹劾，民主党亦准备就国防部的运作展开调查。然而，特朗普总统仍对赫格塞斯表示信任。此外，如果帕帕罗司令访华成行，将是美国太平洋地区最高军事指挥官自2015年以来时隔约11年首次访问中国。中国南京大学国际关系学院院长周峰向《南华早报》评价称，帕帕罗司令访华可能成为加强中美两国军方当局务实层级沟通的契机。据美国国防部介绍，两国国防部门官员于2日至3日在华盛顿举行“危机沟通与预防工作组”年度会议，讨论降低军事风险的办法。此前在8月，帕帕罗司令曾在加拿大会见中国人民解放军东部战区司令杨志斌，并就避免军事误判、加强高级别沟通的重要性交换了意见。报道由KakaoTalk账号okjebo提供。版权所有©韩联社，未经许可禁止转载·再分发及用于人工智能学习和应用。2026年11月8日14时24分发布。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The presidential candidate of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM) , Seyi Makinde, has urged Nigerians to collect money offered by politicians during election campaigns but vote according to their conscience in the 2027 general election. Mr Makinde gave the advice on Saturday in Bauchi State during the flag-off of the APM presidential campaign, where he urged voters not to allow financial inducements to influence their electoral choices. “Don’t bother at all when they bring money, it is your money. Collect it, spend it, but vote your heart. And I know your heart is with us and with APM,” he told supporters. The Oyo State Governor said Nigerians dissatisfied with the country’s current direction must support his proposed Reset Agenda, which he said would address hunger, insecurity and exclusion from governance. He identified hunger as the biggest problem confronting the country and argued that the situation required a fundamental change in economic policies and governance. “Our people are hungry. Because we’re hungry, should we reset the economy? Because there is insecurity, should we reset the security architecture? Because the majority of our people are not allowed to participate, should we reset the socio-political environment in Nigeria?” he asked. Mr Makinde said Nigerians who were unhappy with the lack of inclusion, transparency and sincerity in government had only one option: to reset the country. “If you are not happy with the way things are in our country today, if you’re not happy that there’s not enough inclusivity, if you’re not happy that your government cannot tell you the truth, they cannot handle our issues with sincerity, then there’s only one path for us. And the path is to reset Nigeria,” he said. The campaign flag-off was attended by the APM National Leader and Bauchi State Governor, Bala Mohammed, who urged Nigerians to support Mr Makinde’s presidential ambition. Mr Mohammed said he and the presidential candidate left the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) after experiencing what he described as injustice within the party. He described the APM as a new political platform through which they could pursue their ambitions and promote a more inclusive political system. The governor said Mr Makinde had the experience and capacity to lead Nigeria, citing his performance as governor of Oyo State. He also said the presidential candidate’s proposed government of national unity would address tribalism, religious intolerance and political exclusion. Mr Mohammed, however, urged Mr Makinde to ensure that Bauchi State and the North-east would not be marginalised if he won the presidency. He called for fairness in federal appointments, insisting that government positions should reflect the country’s diversity and adhere to the federal character principle. “There are over 100,000 positions to be filled, but they must not be occupied by one ethnic group alone or skewed in favour of one tribe,” he said. The governor said appointments should balance merit with equitable representation, adding that leadership recruitment must reflect the interests of different sections of the country. He also lamented the financial challenges facing Bauchi State, saying he did not want the state to remain disadvantaged after supporting the APM presidential candidate. “We are even tired of being in the opposition. We have lost a lot. I know how much I suffered as the leader of the opposition. I do not want to come into government only to be marginalised and pushed aside again,” he said. He added that Bauchi needed greater support to meet its financial obligations, including the payment of workers’ salaries. Also speaking, the APM National Chairman, Yusuf Dantalle said the party’s Reset Agenda was designed to address what he described as deceit and hypocrisy in Nigerian politics. He said the party intended to establish a government in which public office holders would be accountable and committed to the welfare of Nigerians, irrespective of their ethnic, religious or social backgrounds. Mr Dantalle said the proposed administration would promote broader participation in governance and develop an agreed national programme to address the country’s challenges. He also called for greater representation of women in political leadership, lamenting the limited number of women in the National Assembly and other decision-making institutions. The chairman disclosed that the party had established a directorate dedicated to women’s affairs and engaged the National Assembly Joint Committee on the proposed special seats for women. He commended the Deputy Speaker of the House of Representatives, Benjamin Kalu, for initiating the proposal, although it did not receive the necessary legislative support. The chairman urged Nigerians to scrutinise the party’s proposals, saying its leadership was prepared to answer difficult questions about its policies and commitments. The APM campaign flag-off marks the beginning of the party’s mobilisation for the 2027 general election, with Mr Makinde seeking to sell his Reset Agenda as an alternative to the country’s current political and economic direction
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 2027年：马金德告诉尼日利亚人，可以收下政客的钱，但应按自己的良知投票
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 人民团结运动（APM）总统候选人塞伊·马金德敦促尼日利亚人在2027年大选期间收下政治人物竞选时提供的钱，但要根据自己的良知投票。马金德先生于星期六在巴乌奇州出席APM总统竞选活动启动仪式时提出这一建议，并敦促选民不要让经济诱惑影响自己的选举选择。“他们拿钱来时，完全不必拒绝，那是属于你的钱。收下它，花掉它，但要遵从自己的内心。我也知道，你们的心与我们同在，与APM同在。”他对支持者说。奥约州州长表示，对国家当前发展方向感到不满的尼日利亚人必须支持他提出的“重置议程”，并称该议程将解决饥饿、治安不善和被排斥在治理之外等问题。他把饥饿列为国家面临的最大问题，主张当前局势需要对经济政策和治理进行根本性改变。“我们的人民正在挨饿。因为我们挨饿，就该重置经济吗？因为存在治安问题，就该重置安全体系吗？因为我们大多数人民无法参与其中，就该重置尼日利亚的社会政治环境吗？”他问道。马金德先生说，对政府缺乏包容性、透明度和诚意感到不满的尼日利亚人只有一种选择：重置国家。“如果你对今天我们国家的状况不满意，如果你对包容性不足不满意，如果你对政府不能向你们坦诚相告不满意，如果他们不能诚心诚意处理我们的问题，那么我们只有一条路。这条路就是重置尼日利亚。”他说。APM全国领导人和巴乌奇州州长 Bala Mohammed出席了竞选活动启动仪式，他敦促尼日利亚人支持马金德先生竞选总统。穆罕默德先生说，他与这位总统候选人是在党内经历了他所描述的不公后离开人民民主党（PDP）的。他将APM称为一个新的政治平台，他们可以通过该平台追求自己的政治抱负，并推动更具包容性的政治制度。州长表示，马金德先生拥有带领尼日利亚的经验和能力，并列举了他担任奥约州州长期间的施政表现。他还说，这位总统候选人提出的民族团结政府将解决部族主义、宗教不宽容和政治排斥问题。然而，穆罕默德先生敦促马金德先生确保，如果当选总统，巴乌奇州和东北地区不会遭到边缘化。他要求联邦任命体现公平，坚持政府职位应反映国家的多样性并遵循联邦性质原则。“有超过100,000个职位需要填补，但这些职位不能只由一个族群占据，也不能向某一个部族倾斜。”他说。州长表示，职位任命应在任人唯贤与公平代表之间取得平衡，领导人才的招聘必须反映全国不同地区的利益。他还感叹巴乌奇州面临的财政困境，表示在支持APM总统候选人后，不希望该州继续处于不利地位。“我们甚至已经厌倦了身处反对派。我们失去了很多。我知道，作为反对派领导人，我吃了多少苦。我不希望进入政府后再次遭到边缘化和排挤。”他说。他补充说，巴乌奇州需要得到更多支持，以履行包括支付工作人员工资在内的各项财政义务。APM全国主席Yusuf Dantalle也在发言时表示，党的“重置议程”旨在解决他所描述的尼日利亚政治中的欺骗和虚伪问题。他说，该党有意建立一个公职人员能够对尼日利亚人民负责并致力于改善其福祉的政府，无论他们来自何种族群、宗教或社会背景。丹塔勒先生说，拟议中的政府将推动更广泛地参与治理，并制定一项各方认可的国家方案，以应对国家面临的各项挑战。他还呼吁提高女性在政治领导层中的代表性，并感叹全国议会和其他决策机构中的女性人数有限。主席透露，该党已经成立一个专门负责妇女事务的机构，并与全国议会联合委员会就拟为女性设立专门席位一事进行了沟通。他赞扬了众议院副议长Benjamin Kalu推动这一提案，尽管该提案没有获得必要的立法支持。主席敦促尼日利亚人审视该党的各项提案，并表示党的领导层准备回答有关政策和承诺的棘手问题。APM竞选活动启动仪式标志着该党开始为2027年大选进行动员，马金德先生希望以自己的“重置议程”作为国家当前政治和经济方向的替代方案

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/rive.body: Nyesom Wike, Minister of the Federal Capital Territory, FCT, said the people of Rivers State have chosen President Bola Tinubu as their candidate in the January 2027 presidential election. Wike said this on Saturday while welcoming Tinubu and his delegation to the Adokiye Amiesimaka Stadium in Port Harcourt for the president’s campaign rally. He is the coordinator of the presidential campaign council in the state. Wike said: “Your Excellency, this is Rivers State’s rally. We did not mobilise anybody from any other state. You can see with your eyes that the people of Rivers State have already concluded and agreed that on January 16, they will vote for you. “Since the inception of democracy in 1999, Rivers people have never had it this way. We have no less than 47 political appointments from Mr President. “So, who is our brother? Our brother is Bola Ahmed Tinubu because he has identified with the people of Rivers state. He described President Tinubu as a political ally of Rivers people, saying the president had demonstrated his commitment to the state through federal projects and political appointments. He questioned the outcome of an alleged fumigation exercise in Rivers, saying it had failed to eliminate mosquitoes. “All we are saying to the vice-presidential candidate is, please, come and give an account of how you fumigated Rivers state. You fumigated Rivers state so that there would be no mosquitoes. He recalled Amaechi’s role as director-general of the presidential campaigns of former President Muhammadu Buhari. Wike said the then APC candidate failed to secure up to 15 percent of the votes in Rivers state in the 2015 and 2019 presidential elections. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: OXFORD — Two tumultuous elections have captured headlines this week. In Brazil, incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defeated his far-right challenger Flávio Bolsonaro. And in Serbia, the student-led opposition ousted Aleksandar Vučić after 14 years in power. But the challenge for these new governments is just beginning. Whether they like it or not, both will be swept up in the global scramble for critical minerals and metals. Critical minerals and metals are essential to build modern infrastructure, implement advanced technologies, and pursue decarbonization. They are vital inputs in electricity grids, wind turbines, solar panels, batteries, electric vehicles, and energy storage. And Brazil and Serbia both possess them: Brazil holds the world’s second-largest reserve of rare earths (after China), estimated at 21 million tons (Mt), and Serbia has significant stores of coal and lithium, as well as copper, gold, and other metals. As it stands, global supplies of these materials, and mining plans for them, are insufficient to meet growing demand. For example, BloombergNEF projects a copper-supply shortfall of 44% of projected global demand by 2050. This has further intensified competition between China and the United States for control of these resources. China is in pole position in this race: the International Energy Agency reports that it is now the top refiner of 19 of 20 key strategic minerals, with an average market share of 70 percent. But the US is committed to strengthening its position. Having identified dependence on China for critical minerals as a key national-security risk, U.S. President Donald Trump has announced billions of dollars in investments in new mineral and mining projects at home and abroad. Resource politics has penetrated almost all corners of U.S. foreign policy, including relations with the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Denmark and Greenland, Ukraine, and Venezuela. In Brazil, the US is trying to contain Chinese mining investment, while re-asserting its preeminence across Latin America. In Serbia, the U.S. government has said for years that a greater presence for American firms is necessary to “displace” China, which has invested “billions of dollars” in mines and other related projects. For countries like Brazil and Serbia, the challenge is to attract the investment they need to leverage their resources for their own benefit, without losing popular support. It is a tricky proposition. Both countries have experienced deadly mining accidents in recent years. In 2019, the Brumadinho dam collapsed, releasing a deluge of toxic mud from Brazil’s Córrego do Feijão iron ore mine that killed 270 people. In 2022, a partial collapse of Serbia’s Soko coal mine led to a sudden release of methane, killing eight miners. If either of these countries is to expand mining operations, the public must trust that it can be done safely. But the Sino-American competition, coupled with soaring global demand, could easily drive down standards in the mining sector. By pushing out companies with better projects, agreements shaped by weak anti-corruption enforcement, conflicts of interest, or hostility toward environmental, social, and governance standards — all of which are apparent in the U.S. nowadays — could lead to less competitive, less safe, and more socially and environmentally harmful arrangements. The US and China want their investments in mining and processing to deliver the biggest and fastest returns possible. Governments in resource-rich countries like Brazil and Serbia will have to navigate such external pressures in a way that does not undermine their legitimacy at home. But mining companies must also build legitimacy in the communities where they operate, lest host countries throw them under the bus if public opinion sours. This has been apparent in Guinea, Mali, and Niger, where governments have lately revoked dozens of mining licenses. In Kenya, the government recently ordered the immediate suspension of mining operations by Tata Chemicals Magadi over “regulatory non-compliance.” Among the issues it identified were the lack of a clear mineral-beneficiation and value-addition strategy, outstanding royalty reconciliation and payment obligations, and inadequate export reporting. Tata Chemicals’ performance was also found wanting when it came to implementing community development agreements, employment and skills-transfer plans for Kenyans, local procurement, and environmental compliance. This is not just a list of terms for the firm’s relationship with government. It captures the broader relationships—with local workers and suppliers, with surrounding communities, and with the nation as a whole—on which the company’s resilience and legitimacy depended. Another recent case reinforces the point. First Quantum’s Cobre Panamá — one of the world’s largest copper mines, which cost some $10 billion to develop and contributed about 5 percent of Panama’s GDP in 2022 — was shuttered in late 2023, following nationwide protests over the mine’s environmental impact. The Canadian company’s original contract included a tax holiday until the capital costs of building the mine were recouped, and a royalty of just 2 percent of revenue. In March 2023, the government made a new deal with First Quantum, which included a 25 percent corporate income tax, 12–16 percent royalties, and a yearly minimum payment of $375 million, in addition to social security contributions, municipal taxes, acreage fees, water charges, and environmental obligations. But Panama’s Supreme Court ruled that the legislation on which that agreement rested violated 25 constitutional articles, covering environmental protection, public welfare, health, and the state’s obligations to its citizens. Panama’s government may yet want to reopen the mine (even if just to shut it sustainably), but any new concession will have to be grounded in legislation aligned with constitutional principles. For mining companies seeking to operate in Brazil, Serbia, or anywhere else, resilience requires more than navigating host-country politics and not getting kicked out. will benefit companies that progress from “tolerated” to “trusted” by offering transparency, respect, and responsiveness to local concerns. Ngaire Woods is dean of the Blavatnik School of Government at the University of Oxford and a non-executive director at Rio Tinto. This article was distributed by Project Syndicate

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 牛津——本周，两场动荡的大选占据 headlines。在巴西，现任总统卢伊兹·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦击败了极右翼挑战者弗拉维奥·博索纳罗。在塞尔维亚，由学生领导的反对派在亚历山大·武契奇执政14年后迫使他下台。但这些新政府面临的挑战才刚刚开始。无论愿不愿意，两国都将被卷入全球争夺关键矿产和金属的竞赛。关键矿产和金属对于建设现代基础设施、实施先进技术以及推进脱碳至关重要。它们是电网、风力涡轮机、太阳能板、电池、电动汽车和储能系统的重要投入品。巴西和塞尔维亚都拥有这些资源：巴西拥有仅次于中国的全球第二大稀土储量，估计达2100万吨（Mt）；塞尔维亚则拥有大量煤炭和锂，以及铜、金和其他金属。目前，全球这些材料的供应及其采矿计划不足以满足不断增长的需求。例如，BloombergNEF预计，到2050年，铜供应缺口将达到预计全球需求的44%。这进一步加剧了中国和美国争夺这些资源控制权的竞争。中国在这场竞赛中处于有利地位：国际能源署报告称，中国现在是20种关键战略矿产中19种的最大精炼国，平均市场份额为70%。但美国决心加强自身地位。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将关键矿产对中国的依赖列为一项关键国家安全风险，并宣布投资数十亿美元在国内及海外建设新的矿产和采矿项目。资源政治已经渗透到美国外交政策的几乎所有角落，包括与刚果民主共和国、丹麦和格陵兰、乌克兰以及委内瑞拉的关系。在巴西，美国试图遏制中国的采矿投资，同时重新确立自己在拉丁美洲的优势。在塞尔维亚，美国政府多年来一直表示，需要让美国企业拥有更广泛的存在，以“取代”中国；中国已在矿山及其他相关项目上投资“数十亿美元”。对于巴西和塞尔维亚这样的国家来说，挑战在于吸引所需投资，利用自身资源为本国谋利，同时不失去公众支持。这是一项微妙的难题。近年来，两国都发生过致命的矿难。2019年，布鲁马迪纽大坝坍塌，巴西科尔雷朱·杜·费热昂铁矿的有毒泥浆洪流决堤，造成270人死亡。2022年，塞尔维亚索科煤矿发生局部坍塌，甲烷突然泄漏，8名矿工死亡。如果这两个国家中的任何一个要扩大采矿业务，公众必须相信采矿能够安全进行。但中美竞争加上全球需求飙升，可能轻易导致采矿行业标准下降。通过排挤拥有更优项目的企业，在反腐败执法不力、利益冲突或敌视环境、社会和治理标准的协议框架下开展业务——这些在美国如今都十分明显——可能导致竞争力更弱、安全性更差，并造成更大社会和环境危害的安排。美国和中国都希望其对采矿和加工的投资获得最大、最快的回报。巴西和塞尔维亚等资源丰富国家的政府将不得不应对这种外部压力，同时不损害自身在国内的合法性。但矿业公司也必须在所在社区建立合法性，否则一旦公众舆论转坏，东道国可能会把公司当成弃子。这一情况在几内亚、马里和尼日尔十分明显，这些国家的政府最近撤销了数十张采矿许可证。在肯尼亚，政府最近以“违反监管规定”为由，命令 Tata Chemicals Magadi 立即暂停采矿业务。其认定的问题包括缺乏明确的矿产选冶和增值战略、未完成的特许权使用费核算与支付义务，以及出口报告不足。在执行社区发展协议、为肯尼亚人制定就业和技能转移计划、本地采购以及环境合规方面，Tata Chemicals 的表现也被认为不尽如人意。这不仅仅是一系列涉及公司与政府关系的条款。它涵盖了更广泛的关系——与当地工人和供应商、周边社区以及整个国家的关系——而公司的韧性和合法性正依赖于这些关系。另一个近期案例进一步印证了这一点。First Quantum 的 Cobre Panamá 铜矿是全球最大的铜矿之一，开发成本约100亿美元，2022年贡献了巴拿马国内生产总值约5%，但在2023年末因该矿的环境影响引发全国性抗议而被关闭。这家加拿大公司的原始合同包括税收假期，直至建矿的资本成本收回；此外还有仅占收入2%的特许权使用费。2023年3月，政府与 First Quantum 达成新协议，规定征收25%的企业所得税、12%至16%的特许权使用费以及每年最低付款3.75亿美元，此外还须缴纳社会保障金、地方税、土地面积费、水资源费并履行环境义务。但巴拿马最高法院裁定，该协议所依据的法律违反了宪法中的25项条款，涉及环境保护、公共福利、健康以及国家对公民所承担的义务。巴拿马政府或许仍希望重新开放这座矿山（即便只是为了以可持续方式关闭它），但任何新的特许协议都必须建立在符合宪法原则的法律基础上。对于希望进入巴西、塞尔维亚或其他任何地方经营的矿业公司而言，仅需应对东道国政治并避免被赶出去，并不足以构成韧性。提供透明度、尊重并回应地方关切，将有助于企业从“被容忍”转变为“受信任”。Ngaire Woods 是牛津大学布拉瓦特尼克政府学院院长，也是力拓的非执行董事。本文由 Project Syndicate 分发

According to him, voters may take and spend the money offered to them, but should support the candidate they consider necessary. The candidate said he was proposing the Reset Agenda program, which, according to him, should help address the problems of hunger, security and citizens’ participation in governing the country. Makinde called hunger the country’s biggest problem and stressed the need for changes in economic policy, the security system and the socio-political environment. He also stated the need for greater inclusiveness, transparency and sincerity in government. Makinde called on those dissatisfied with the country’s current development path to support his proposal to reset Nigeria. More current news is available on the UA.News Telegram channel Telegram . The event was attended by APM national leader and Bauchi State Governor Bala Mohammed. He urged voters to support Makinde and said they had left the Peoples Democratic Party after what he called injustice within that political force. Mohammed asked Makinde, if he wins, to prevent the marginalization of Bauchi State and northeastern Nigeria. According to him, federal appointments should combine candidates’ professional qualities with fair representation of different parts of the country. For his part, APM chairman Yusuf Dantalle said the party seeks to form an accountable government and expand women’s participation in political leadership

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/08/o.summary: The presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), Mr. Peter Obi, has challenged President Bola Tinubu to visit the remaining 33 states of the federation and account for the over $100billion in loans obtained by his administration and N15.8trillion reportedly saved from the removal of the fuel subsidy.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/08/o.summary_zh: 尼日利亚民主党（NDC）总统候选人Peter Obi先生challenge总统Bola Tinubu，要求他访问联邦其余33个州，并说明其政府取得的超过1000亿美元贷款，以及据称因取消燃油补贴而节省的15.8万亿奈拉。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/08/o.body: The presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), Mr. Peter Obi, has challenged President Bola Tinubu to visit the remaining 33 states of the federation and account for the over $100billion in loans obtained by his administration and N15.8trillion reportedly saved from the removal of the fuel subsidy. This is as the NDC has accused President Tinubu’s administration of eroding Nigeria’s commonwealth through excessive borrowing, poor fiscal management and inadequate investment in critical public services, declaring that Obi and his running mate, Senator Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso, would reverse the trend if elected in 2027. Obi said Nigerians deserved to know how the resources accruing to the federal government through increased revenue, taxation, borrowing and subsidy removal had been utilised since Tinubu assumed office. The former Anambra State governor made the demand in a statement issued yesterday and addressed to the president, titled ‘Good Day, Mr. President: Nigerians Deserve Accountability’. Obi’s comments followed Tinubu’s recent visit to Akwa Ibom State. Congratulating Tinubu on the visit, Obi said he hoped it would encourage the president to travel to other parts of the country and engage Nigerians on his administration’s performance. “I congratulate you on spending a night in one of Nigeria’s states outside Lagos and Abuja. I hope you enjoyed the warmth, hospitality, and delicious cuisine of Akwa Ibom,” he said. He, however, questioned the president’s foreign travels, alleging that Tinubu had spent over 260 days outside Nigeria since assuming office. “I sincerely hope this visit will inspire you to travel to the remaining 33 states of the federation, spend time with the people and, more importantly, explain what your administration has done with the N15.8 trillion saved from the removal of the fuel subsidy, the over $100 billion you have borrowed,” Obi stated. He also asked the president to account for the increased revenues accruing to the government from taxation and other sources, including additional revenues the administration reportedly celebrated last year as exceeding its target. The NDC presidential candidate said Nigerians deserved measurable evidence of improvements in their living conditions, particularly in poverty reduction, education, healthcare, electricity supply and national security. He asked the federal government to disclose how many Nigerians it lifted out of poverty under the administration, as well as how many out-of-school children it returned to classrooms. Obi also demanded information on how many functional primary healthcare centres the government built. On electricity, he questioned how much the power supply had improved, recalling Tinubu’s promise that Nigerians should not vote for him if he failed to fix the country’s electricity challenges. “They also deserve to know how much electricity supply has improved, especially given your promise that if you do not fix power, Nigerians should not vote for you,” he said. On security, Obi called for an explanation of the administration’s efforts to secure the country, noting that Nigeria remained among the most terrorised countries in the world. He maintained that the government owed citizens an explanation of how it had spent public resources, insisting that Nigerians deserved answers on the administration’s performance. “Mr. President, Nigerians deserve answers. They deserve to know what has been done with the resources entrusted to your government,” he said. Obi added that accountability, transparency and measurable improvements in citizens’ welfare should form the foundation of the country’s development. “The new Nigeria we want to build will be based on accountability, transparency, and the physical, measurable impact of our public resources on the lives of citizens,” he said. NDC: Obi, Kwankwaso Will End Tinubu’s Borrowing-Driven Governance Meanwhile, the NDC has declared that the Obi-Kwankwaso ticket was committed to ending what it described as a borrowing-dependent model of governance and replacing it with prudent management of public resources, accountability and productive investments capable of improving citizens’ welfare. The NDC said this in a statement issued yesterday by its National Presidential Campaign Council spokesperson, Dr. Chiogo Constance Ikokwu, in response to Tinubu’s criticism of Obi over the persistent gully erosion menace in Anambra State. It argued that the former Anambra State governor’s political ambition went beyond addressing erosion in his home state, insisting that his broader mission was to halt the alleged erosion of Nigeria’s national wealth. The party questioned the economic benefits of removing the petrol subsidy, demanding explanations for what happened to the anticipated fiscal gains, particularly amid the federal government’s continued borrowing and what it described as inadequate funding of essential public services. It also expressed concern over the country’s rising debt profile, poor debt-service-to-revenue ratio and the persistent underfunding of healthcare and education. According to the NDC, Nigerians deserve to know why increased revenue generation and the removal of the fuel subsidy have not translated into improved public services and better living conditions. “Obi-Kwankwaso will not allow Nigeria to continue borrowing at an alarming rate, without corresponding benefits, while citizens endure worsening poverty, unemployment, insecurity and declining purchasing power,” the party said. To strengthen its argument on fiscal management, the NDC compared the financial records of Obi and Tinubu during their respective tenures as governors of Anambra and Lagos states. It claimed that Obi left the equivalent of $500 million in investments and local and foreign currency assets when he handed over power in Anambra State in 2014, including $156 million in dollar-denominated bonds. In contrast, the party cited Debt Management Office figures which, it said, put Lagos State’s external debt at approximately $190.43 million at the end of 2007, when Tinubu left office. The NDC also criticised the pension law enacted during Tinubu’s administration in Lagos, which provided lifetime benefits for former governors and their deputies. It alleged that the law entitled former governors and their deputies to pensions equivalent to 100 per cent of the incumbent governor’s basic salary, houses in Lagos and Abuja, multiple vehicles, furniture and utility allowances, entertainment benefits, free medical care and other privileges. The party described the provisions as excessive, arguing that they placed unnecessary pressure on public resources. It further claimed that a subsequent Lagos administration was compelled to review some of the provisions, while Obi did not establish a similar pension arrangement for former governors in Anambra State. The NDC maintained that the 2027 presidential election would give Nigerians a choice between what it described as Tinubu’s borrowing-dependent economic model and the Obi-Kwankwaso commitment to fiscal discipline and accountability. Warning against unsustainable borrowing, the party referenced the financial difficulties experienced by countries such as Argentina and Zambia, as well as historical examples involving the Ottoman Empire and 19th-century Egypt. It argued that excessive debt accumulation, without corresponding productive investments and effective fiscal management, could undermine national development and threaten future generations. On the erosion controversy that prompted the statement, the NDC defended Obi’s record, saying his administration took steps to address gully erosion and flooding in Anambra State. It said Obi helped attract and launch the World Bank-supported Nigeria Erosion and Watershed Management Project (NEWMAP) in the state. The party also cited the former governor’s directive that new state roads should incorporate adequate drainage systems connected to safe discharge points. It listed concrete drainage and local flood-control projects executed in communities, including Adazi Nnukwu, Amawbia and Umuoji, as evidence of his administration’s efforts to tackle environmental challenges. The NDC added that Obi regularly engaged the federal government to secure ecological intervention funds for the state, while emphasising accountability in their utilisation. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/08/o.body_zh:
尼日利亚民主党（NDC）总统候选人彼得·奥比先生挑战总统博拉·蒂努布，要求其走访联邦其余33个州，并说明其政府取得的逾1000亿美元贷款以及据报道因取消燃油补贴而节省的15.8万亿奈拉资金的用途。与此同时，NDC指责蒂努布政府通过过度借贷、糟糕的财政管理和对关键公共服务投资不足，侵蚀尼日利亚的共同财富，并宣称如果奥比及其竞选搭档、拉布·穆萨·夸恩克瓦索在2027年当选，将扭转这一趋势。奥比说，尼日利亚人民理应了解，自蒂努布就任以来，联邦政府通过增加收入、税收、借贷和取消补贴所获得的资源是如何使用的。前阿南布拉州州长在昨天发表并致总统的声明《总统先生，早上好：尼日利亚人民应得到问责》中提出这一要求。奥比的评论紧随蒂努布近期访问阿夸伊博姆州之后。奥比祝贺蒂努布此次访问，并希望这能鼓励总统前往该国其他地区，与尼日利亚人民交流其政府的施政表现。他说：“我祝贺您在拉各斯和阿布贾之外的尼日利亚一个州度过了一夜。希望您享受了阿夸伊博姆的热情、款待和美味佳肴。”不过，他质疑总统的海外出访，称蒂努布就任以来已在尼日利亚境外度过超过260天。奥比表示：“我真诚希望此次访问能促使您前往联邦其余33个州，与民众共度时光，更重要的是，解释您的政府如何处置了取消燃油补贴后节省的15.8万亿奈拉，以及您借入的逾1000亿美元。”他还要求总统说明政府通过征税和其他来源获得的增加收入，包括据报道政府去年庆祝其超过目标的额外收入。这名NDC总统候选人表示，尼日利亚人民理应看到生活水平改善的可衡量证据，尤其是在减贫、教育、医疗、供电和国家安全方面。他要求联邦政府公布在政府任内使多少尼日利亚人摆脱贫困，以及让多少失学儿童重返课堂。奥比还要求提供有关政府建设了多少所能够正常运转的基层医疗中心的信息。在电力问题上，他质疑供电改善了多少，并援引蒂努布曾作出的承诺：如果他未能解决该国的电力难题，尼日利亚人民就不应投票给他。奥比说：“他们还理应了解供电改善了多少，尤其是鉴于您曾承诺，如果不能解决电力问题，尼日利亚人民就不应投票给您。”在安全问题上，奥比要求解释政府为保障国家安全所做的努力，并指出尼日利亚仍是世界上遭受恐怖主义袭击最严重的国家之一。他坚持认为，政府有义务向公民说明公共资金的使用情况，并强调尼日利亚人民理应得到有关政府施政表现的答案。奥比说：“总统先生，尼日利亚人民理应得到答案。他们理应知道，交给您政府的资源被用于了什么。”奥比补充说，问责、透明度和公民福祉可衡量的改善，应成为国家发展的基础。他说：“我们想要建设的新尼日利亚，将以问责、透明度以及公共资源对公民生活产生的实际、可衡量影响为基础。”

NDC：奥比和夸恩克瓦索将终结蒂努布依赖借贷的治理模式
与此同时，NDC宣称，奥比—夸恩克瓦索组合致力于终结其所称的依赖借贷的治理模式，转而采用审慎的公共资源管理、问责和有益生产性投资，以改善公民福祉。NDC是在昨天由其全国总统竞选委员会发言人奇奥戈·康斯坦丝·伊科库博士发表的声明中作出上述表态的，以回应蒂努布针对奥比未能解决阿南布拉州持续严重的沟蚀问题的批评。声明认为，前阿南布拉州州长的政治抱负超出了治理家乡沟蚀问题的范畴，坚持认为其更宏大的使命是遏制据称对尼日利亚国家财富的侵蚀。该党质疑取消汽油补贴带来的经济效益，要求解释预期财政收益的去向，尤其是在联邦政府持续借贷以及其所称的基本公共服务资金不足的情况下。NDC还对该国不断上升的债务规模、糟糕的偿债收入比以及医疗和教育长期资金不足表示担忧。据NDC称，尼日利亚人民理应知道，为何增加收入和取消燃油补贴没有转化为更好的公共服务和更优的生活条件。该党说：“奥比—夸恩克瓦索不会任由尼日利亚在没有相应收益的情况下继续以惊人速度借贷，同时让公民忍受日益恶化的贫困、失业、不安全局势和下降的购买力。”为进一步强化其关于财政管理的论点，NDC比较了奥比和蒂努布分别担任阿南布拉州州长和拉各斯州州长期间的财务记录。该党声称，2014年奥比在阿南布拉州移交政权时，留下了相当于5亿美元的投资以及本币和外币资产，其中包括1.56亿美元的美元计价债券。相比之下，该党援引债务管理办公室的数据称，2007年底蒂努布离任时，拉各斯州外债约为1.9043亿美元。NDC还批评了蒂努布在拉各斯任内通过的养老金法，该法向前任州长和副州长提供终身福利。该党指控，该法使前任州长和副州长有权获得相当于在任州长基本工资100%的养老金，以及在拉各斯和阿布贾的住房、多辆汽车、家具和水电津贴、娱乐福利、免费医疗和其他特权。该党称这些条款过于优厚，给公共资源造成不必要的压力。它还声称，之后的拉各斯州政府被迫重新审视其中部分条款，而奥比并未在阿南布拉州为前任州长设立类似的养老金安排。NDC坚持认为，2027年总统选举将让尼日利亚人民在其所称的蒂努布依赖借贷的经济模式，以及奥比—夸恩克瓦索对财政纪律和问责的承诺之间作出选择。该党警告不要进行不可持续的借贷，并援引阿根廷和赞比亚等国家经历的财政困难，以及奥斯曼帝国和19世纪埃及的历史案例作为例证。NDC认为，如果没有相应的生产性投资和有效的财政管理，过度累积债务可能削弱国家发展并威胁后代。在促使该党发表声明的沟蚀争议中，NDC为奥比的历史政绩辩护，称其政府采取措施应对了阿南布拉州的沟蚀和洪涝问题。NDC说，奥比帮助吸引并启动世界银行支持的尼日利亚侵蚀与流域管理项目（NEWMAP）。该党还提到，这位前州长曾指示新建州道必须纳入完善的排水系统，并与安全排水口相连。NDC列举了阿达齐·恩努克武、阿马夫比亚和乌穆奥吉等社区实施的具体排水和地方防洪工程，作为其政府努力应对环境挑战的证据。NDC补充说，奥比经常与联邦政府接洽，为该州争取生态干预资金，同时强调这些资金使用过程中的问责。

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.title_zh: 4名中国军队将领辞去全国人大代表职务，3年来已有50人失去代表资格
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）权淑姬记者＝中国军队近期有4名少将退出全国人民代表大会（相当于韩国国会）代表职务。据路透社和中国经济媒体财新等8日报道，6日在北京闭幕的第十四届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第二十五次会议宣布，人民解放军少将等共9人辞去全国人大代表职务。辞去职务的4名少将中，包括广东省军区司令员张弓此前和宁夏军区政委郭建军等。此前在今年举行的全国人大常委会会议上，也有多名军队高级将领和国防工业相关人士被取消全国人大代表资格。财新统计称，自习近平担任中国国家主席并展开强力反腐行动以来，已有数十名高级将领和军官受到清洗。财新称，自第十四届全国人大于2023年产生以来，3年间共有46名来自人民解放军和武警部队的全国人大代表被免职。军队和武警部队所属全国人大代表此次并非被免职，而是以辞职方式离开代表职务，这是2023年以来首次。报道可通过KakaoTalk联系okjebo。版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再发布及用于人工智能学习与利用。2026年11月8日13时43分发布。

https://www.bbc.com/hausa/articles/cq5yn.summary_zh: 在乍得当地时间2026年3月3日星期二举行的美国国会选举中，原定选举众议院和参议院议员。此前，一些人士在国会选举中取得了出人意料的成果，其中包括一些尼日利亚及其他非洲国家议员在两院赢得席位。
https://www.bbc.com/hausa/articles/cq5yn.body: An wallafa Sa'o'i 2 da suka wuce Lokacin karatu: Minti 3 An gudanar da zaɓen Majalisar Dokokin Amurka ranar Talata, 3 ga watan Nuwamba, 2026, domin zaɓen mambobin majalisar biyu, wato Majalisar Dattawa da Majalisar Wakilai. Sakamakon zaɓen ya nuna cewa jam'iyyar Democrat ta samu kujeru fiye da jam'iyyar Republican, wadda Shugaba Donald Trump yake wakilta. A yayin zaɓen, an samu wasu abubuwa da ba a yi tsammani ba, ciki har da nasarar 'yan Najeriya da sauran Baƙaƙen fata da suka samu kujeru a majalisun dokokin Amurka. Fiye da 'yan takara goma sha biyu ’yan asalin Najeriya sun samu nasarar lashe kujerun wakiltar mazabu daban-daban a Amurka, ciki har da waɗanda ke jihohin Maryland, Texas, Pennsylvania da Georgia, da kuma birnin Washington DC. Will Jawando ya samu nasarar lashe zaɓen shugabancin gundumar Montgomery da ke jihar Maryland, bayan ya kayar da Esther Wells ta jam'iyyar Republican. Ofishin babban jami’in tsaro na gundumar Montgomery ya naɗa Jawando a matsayin sabon shugaban rundunar 'yan sandan yankin. Jawando mamba ne a Majalisar Gundumar Montgomery. Dan asalin Najeriya ne, kasancewar mahaifinsa ɗan Najeriya ne, yayin da mahaifiyarsa Ba'amurkiya ce. A jihar Texas, Junior Ezeonu mai shekaru 27 ya samu nasarar lashe zaɓen kujerar wakilcin mazaɓa ta 101 a Majalisar Wakilan Jihar, bayan ya kayar da ɗan majalisar mai ci, Chris Turner, a zaɓen fitar da gwani. An haifi Ezeonu a Onitsha, jihar Anambra ta Najeriya, amma ya koma jihar Texas da ke Amurka yana ɗan shekara biyu. A shekarar 2021, an zaɓe shi a matsayin mamba a Majalisar Ƙaramar Hukumar Grand Prairie. Daga baya kuma ya zama mutum mafi ƙarancin shekaru da ya taɓa riƙe muƙamin mataimakin magajin garin na wucin gadi a tarihin birnin. Carol Kazeem, 'yar jam'iyyar Democrat, ta sake lashe zaɓen kujerar wakilcin mazaɓa ta 159 a Majalisar Wakilan Jihar Pennsylvania. Kazeem na daga cikin 'yan siyasa baƙaƙen fata na farko da suka samu nasarar lashe kujerun majalisa a Amurka a zaɓen shekarar 2022. A birnin Washington DC, Oye Owolewa ya samu nasarar lashe ɗaya daga cikin kujerun wakilci na bai ɗaya a Majalisar Gundumar Columbia. Owolewa, wanda masani ne a fannin harhaɗa magunguna, iyayensa sun fito daga jihohin Kwara da Osun ne na Najeriya, waɗanda suka yi hijira zuwa Amurka. A baya, ya riƙe muƙamin wakilin je-ka na-yi-ka Gundumar Columbia (Shadow Representative). Kundin tsarin mulkin Amurka ya tanadi cewa Gundumar Columbia za ta kasance jiha mai cin gashin kanta. Sai dai har yanzu ba ta da cikakken ikon kaɗa ƙuri'a a Majalisar Wakilan Amurka. Adeyina, wanda aka haifa a Najeriya kuma mamba ne a jam'iyyar Democrat, ya sake lashe zaɓe domin komawa Majalisar Dokokin Jihar Georgia. An fara zaɓen Adeyina zuwa Majalisar Wakilan Jihar Georgia ne a shekarar 2022, inda yake wakiltar wasu sassan gundumar Gwinnett. Shi ne babban daraktan kwamitin ba da shawarwari ga al'ummar Najeriya mazauna Amurka (Nigerian American Public Advisory Committee), wata ƙungiya da ke wayar da kan jama'a kan muhimmancin zaɓe, tare da taimaka wa baƙin haure da ke zaune a Amurka wajen yin rajistar zaɓe. Shi ma Gabe Okoye na jam'iyyar Democrat ya sake lashe zaɓe, inda zai koma Majalisar Dokokin Jihar Georgia domin ci gaba da wakiltar mazaɓa ta 102. https://www.bbc.com/hausa/articles/cq5yn.body_zh: 美国国会中期选举再过2天：周二，即2026年11月3日，将举行美国国会选举，选举众议院参议院和众议院议员。结果显示，民主党获得的席位比共和党多，共和党由总统唐纳德·特朗普代表。选举结果还出现了一些出人意料的情况，包括尼日利亚裔人士和其他亚裔人士在美国国会中取得进展。超过12名尼日利亚出生的候选人成功赢得美国不同选区的代表席位，其中包括马里兰州、得克萨斯州、宾夕法尼亚州、佐治亚州以及华盛顿特区。Will Jawando在击败共和党的Esther Wells后，成功赢得马里兰州蒙哥马利县县长选举，蒙哥马利县治安官办公室任命Jawando为新的县治安官。Jawando是蒙哥马利县议会成员。他是尼日利亚裔，父亲是尼日利亚人，母亲是美国人。在得克萨斯州，27岁的Junior Ezeonu在初选中击败现任议员Chris Turner后，成功赢得得克萨斯州众议院第101选区代表席位。Ezeonu出生于尼日利亚阿南布拉州奥尼察，但两年前移居美国得克萨斯州。2021年，他当选为大草原市法律市议会成员。后来，他又成为该市历史上最年轻的市政议员副手候选人。民主党人Carol Kazeem再次赢得宾夕法尼亚州众议院第159选区代表席位。Kazeem属于首批赢得美国议会议席的非裔美国政治人士，这些人士在2022年选举中取得突破。在华盛顿特区，Oye Owolewa赢得哥伦比亚特区议会仅有的一个代表席位。Owolewa以反毒工作闻名，父母来自尼日利亚夸拉州和奥孙州，后来移民美国。此后，他担任哥伦比亚特区影子代表。美国的政府体制规定，哥伦比亚特区应享有州级地位，但目前仍未在美国众议院获得完整的投票权。出生于尼日利亚的民主党人Adeyina再次当选，重新返回佐治亚州众议院。2022年，Adeyina首次竞选佐治亚州众议院议员，代表格温内特县的其他乡村地区。他是旅美尼日利亚人公共咨询委员会（Nigerian American Public Advisory Committee）的主席，该组织向公众宣传选举的重要性，并协助居住在美国的大批非洲人登记投票。民主党人Gabe Okoye也再次赢得选举，将返回佐治亚州众议院，继续代表第102选区。2024年美国选举 尼日利亚 唐纳德·特朗普 美国政治 突发 特朗普 连任 竞选活动 02:04 视频、Tinubu可能面临的州份 2027年选举、2分04秒 01:11 视频、PSG是世界上哪支最强的足球队？、1分11秒 02:18 视频、是什么引发了Kwankwaso与ADC之间的冲突？、2分18秒 04:04 视频、‘我与南方同僚建立了牢固关系’、4分04秒 01:40 视频、Ilhan Omar：谁在众议院与特朗普针锋相对？、1分40秒 01:28 视频、尼日利亚2027年可能出现的5位女性总统人选、1分28秒 04:46 视频、‘Hollywood演员比女性承担更多责任’、4分46秒 01:45 视频、在尼日利亚导致儿童早婚和失去受教育机会的因素、1分45秒 02:41 视频、仍在为尼日利亚推动足球的北方人、2分41秒 03:50 视频、如何确认你的号码是否在NCC关闭之列、3分50秒 01:39 视频、是什么让Tinubu的选举委员会陷入困境？、1分39秒 01:39 视频、尼日利亚最贫困的州份、1分39秒 03:04 视频、尼日利亚公民在2027年前面临的困境、3分04秒 02:04 视频、这位百岁老人正在书写历史、2分04秒 特朗普连任竞选结束

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 장하나 기자 = 국토교통부는 오는 13일 서울 전문건설회관 대회의실에서 '새로운 대한민국의 내일을 잇는 철도 대전환'을 주제로 '제5차 국가철도망 구축계획(2026∼2035)'(이하 제5차 철도망 계획) 의견수렴 행사를 연다고 8일 밝혔다. 이번 행사는 제5차 철도망 계획 수립·고시에 앞서 국민·지방정부·전문가 등 다양한 의견을 폭넓게 듣기 위해 마련됐다. 먼저 한국교통연구원이 미래 30년 철도 중심의 교통체계 전환을 위한 제5차 철도망 계획의 비전과 목표를 소개하고, 지방정부는 지역별 핵심사업과 기대 효과를 설명한다. 이어지는 전문가 토론에서는 교통·국토 분야 전문가와 시민단체 등이 미래 철도의 역할, 철도투자의 필요성과 적정 규모, 지역균형발전 효과, 예비타당성조사를 비롯한 관련 제도의 개선방안 등을 논의한다. 국민이 직접 의견을 제시할 수 있도록 사전 설문조사와 행사 당일 현장·온라인 의견수렴을 병행하고 온라인 생중계(국토교통부 유튜브 채널)도 한다. 김태병 국토교통부 철도국장은 "철도망은 오늘의 이동 편의를 넘어 향후 30년의 국민 생활과 지역발전을 내다보고 준비해야 한다"며 "국민 사전설문조사(QR코드) 등을 통해 수렴된 국민과 지역의 목소리를 충실히 담아 계획을 마련하겠다"고 말했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/08 12:10 송고 2026년11월08일 12시10분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110802.title_zh: 政府将于13日就“与国民共同描绘未来铁路网络”征求意见

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/08/n.summary: This is just as the Minister of Power, Mr. Joseph Tegbe, yesterday promised that electricity supply to Abuja, Lagos, Kwara and Oyo states, which were currently experiencing outages would improve within the next 24 hours. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/08/n.summary_zh: 就在电力部长Joseph Tegbe先生昨日承诺，向目前正遭遇停电的阿布贾、拉各斯、夸拉州和奥约州供应电力将在未来24小时内得到改善。NNPCL首席企业传播官Andy Odeh昨日在一份声明中表示，由NNPC子公司NNPC Gas Infrastructure Company Limited（NGIC）运营的天然气网络仍可支持向全国各发电站输送天然气。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/08/n.body: • Abuja, Lagos, Kwara, Oyo to get improved supply in 24 hours The Nigerian National Petroleum Company (NNPC) Limited has countered the claims by the Nigerian Independent System Operator (NISO), and the Federal Ministry of Power that operational constraints on gas transportation network was responsible for the recent decline in electricity generation. This is just as the Minister of Power, Mr. Joseph Tegbe, yesterday promised that electricity supply to Abuja, Lagos, Kwara and Oyo states, which were currently experiencing outages would improve within the next 24 hours. The Transmission Company of Nigeria (TCN) has also rejected claims by Ikeja Electric (IKEDC), attributing several Band A feeder outages to “grid instability” and assigning responsibility to the transmission company. NNPCL’s Chief Corporate Communications Officer, Andy Odeh, said in a statement yesterday that the gas network operated by NNPC Gas Infrastructure Company Limited (NGIC), a subsidiary of the NNPC, remained available to support gas deliveries to power-generating stations nationwide. “NGIC’s operational records do not indicate transportation-related constraints within its network that explain the current decline in electricity generation,” Odeh said. NNPC’s clarification followed a November 5 statement by the NISO, which attributed the lower power generation partly to limited gas availability and reduced water inflows into hydroelectric stations. Specifically, the system operator said the limited availability of “gas has constrained the capacity of affected thermal generating stations to operate at their available levels, while reduced water inflows into reservoirs have impacted the generation capacity of hydroelectric power stations”. Tegbe also attributed the electricity supply shortfall to planned maintenance at the Egbin Power Station in Lagos and constraints in gas supply to some thermal power stations, which had reduced the amount of electricity available on the national grid. “Grid operators have, therefore, implemented load shedding in some areas to manage the shortfall. Sabotage of key transmission lines has also restricted the use of alternative routes to supply some locations, especially Lagos,” the minister explained. But the NNPC said the availability of its gas transportation infrastructure should be assessed separately from gas production, commercial supply arrangements, and actual deliveries to individual power plants. The company said gas production volumes had grown by about 10 percent year-to-date in 2026, citing efforts to implement the federal government’s gas development and monetisation agenda. “Gas supply availability is therefore not a challenge as NNPC remains committed to supporting efforts to improve electricity generation through safe, reliable and efficient gas supply and transportation,” it said. The company said determining the cause of the power shortfall required a broader assessment of the gas-to-power value chain. According to the oil firm, the review should cover the availability and operational readiness of generating units, plant maintenance schedules, and actual gas offtake, noting that these factors determine whether gas supplied to power plants can be converted into electricity. “Gas production, commercial supply arrangements and actual deliveries to individual power plants must be assessed separately from the availability of transportation infrastructure,” the NNPC said. The company called for a coordinated review of operational data by gas suppliers, transporters, power generators, and NISO to identify specific constraints and determine appropriate interventions. In an update on the power situation, Tegbe said he was aware of the strain the outages had placed on households and businesses in the four affected areas. Tegbe said his team was working to return the affected generating units to service in phases, with the first units expected to come back online within 48 to 72 hours, counting down from yesterday. He said the ministry was also working with operators to improve gas supply and accelerate repairs to the damaged infrastructure. Tegbe also applauded residents of the affected states for their patience. “I thank everyone affected for their patience and will provide further updates as supply is gradually restored,” he stated. The current outages, which have lasted several days, have hit the four states, leaving many households and businesses in extended blackout and forcing reliance on alternative power sources. In the areas impacted by the power cuts, Discos had announced load shedding schedules, with many Band A customers complaining of sharp drops in supply hours. The situation, the minister earlier said, was compounded by reduced generation from hydro stations due to low water levels, gas constraints to thermal stations, among others, which he stressed limited wheeling to the power distributors. Meanwhile, the TCN has rejected claims by IKEDC attributing several Band A feeder outages to “grid instability”. In a statement TCN issued yesterday, the transmission company said the attribution contained in IKEDC’s public notice of November 5 was “inaccurate and misleading.” TCN said by virtue of Section 67 of the Electricity Act, 2023, the determination of the root cause of disturbances, shortfalls and interruptions on the national grid falls exclusively within the defined functions of the Nigerian Independent System Operator (NISO). “IKEDC, like every other market participant, has no authority to make such determinations, and NISO has made none attributing the outages in IKEDC’s notice to TCN,” it said. The company said NISO had already clarified the position in its public statement of November 5, attributing the current decline in power generation to constraints in gas supply to thermal power stations and reduced output from hydroelectric stations due to lower reservoir inflows. According to TCN, NISO explained that the development reduced available generation, which in turn reduced energy allocated to Discos and led to fewer hours of supply and increased load shedding across distribution networks. “The shortfall in supply to IKEDC’s customers is a consequence of reduced generation and the resulting allocation, not of any failure of TCN’s transmission network. TCN can only transmit the energy made available to it and cannot transmit energy that is not generated,” it said. TCN said records for all feeders supplying IKEDC confirmed the picture painted by NISO. Of the interruptions recorded on November 1 and 2, it said 68 per cent were frequency-control load shedding arising from low generation, 26 per cent were due to IKEDC’s non-compliance with load allocation by the National Control Centre (NCC) of NISO, or to faults and works on IKEDC’s own network, while the remaining 6 per cent were TCN planned maintenance, switching or a line limitation. “None of the recorded interruptions was a TCN equipment fault or trip,” it added. Of the 46 interruptions recorded on the 33kV feeders named in IKEDC’s notice, TCN said 29 were frequency-control load shedding arising from low generation and 14 were recorded against IKEDC – nine for non-compliance with load allocation and five for faults or trips on its own network. According to the TCN, the other three were scheduled for maintenance on the Ogba-Alimosho line on November 1. TCN urged IKEDC and other Discos to “desist forthwith from making unfounded claims about the causes of supply shortfalls to their customers,” saying such claims misinformed customers, undermined public confidence and obscured the real challenges to be resolved by the relevant stakeholders. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/08/n.body_zh: 阿布贾、拉各斯、夸拉和奥约州将在24小时内获得改善的电力供应。尼日利亚国家石油公司（NNPC） Limited反驳了尼日利亚独立系统运营商（NISO）和联邦电力部的说法，后者称天然气运输网络的运行限制是近期发电量下降的原因。电力部长约瑟夫·特格比先生昨天承诺，目前正经历停电的阿布贾、拉各斯、夸拉州和奥约州的电力供应将在未来24小时内改善。尼日利亚输电公司（TCN）也否定了 Ikeja Electric（IKEDC）的说法。IKEDC将多条A类馈线停电归因于“电网不稳定”，并把责任推给输电公司。NNPCL首席企业传播官安迪·奥德昨天在一份声明中表示，由NNPC子公司NNPC天然气基础设施有限公司（NGIC）运营的天然气网络仍可支持向全国发电站输送天然气。“NGIC的运行记录并未显示其网络内存在可以解释当前发电量下降的运输相关限制，”奥德说。NNPC的澄清紧随NISO于11月5日发表的声明。该声明将发电量下降部分归因于天然气供应有限以及水电站入水量减少。系统运营商具体表示，天然气供应有限“制约了受影响的火力发电站按可用水平运行，而水库入水量减少影响了水电站的发电能力”。特格比还把电力供应不足归因于拉各斯Egbin发电站的计划检修，以及部分火力发电站面临的天然气供应限制，这些因素减少了国家电网可供应的电量。“因此，电网运营商已在部分地区实施限电，以管理供应缺口。关键输电线路遭到破坏也限制了通过替代路线向一些地点供电，尤其是拉各斯，”部长解释道。但NNPC表示，评估其天然气运输基础设施的可用性时，应将其与天然气生产、商业供应安排以及向各电厂的实际交付分别开来。公司称，2026年初至今天然气产量增长约10%，并将此归因于落实联邦政府天然气开发与变现议程的努力。“因此，天然气供应的可获得性并非挑战，因为NNPC仍致力于通过安全、可靠和高效的天然气供应与运输，支持改善发电量的努力。”公司表示，要确定电力供应短缺的原因，需要对从天然气到电力的价值链进行更广泛的评估。这家石油企业称，审查应涵盖各发电机组的可用性和运行准备状态、电厂检修计划以及天然气实际提取量，并指出这些因素决定供应给电厂的天然气能否转化为电力。“天然气生产、商业供应安排以及向各电厂的实际交付，必须与运输基础设施的可用性分开评估，”NNPC说。公司呼吁天然气供应商、运输商、发电企业和NISO协调审查运行数据，以查明具体限制因素并确定适当的干预措施。在有关电力局势的最新通报中，特格比表示，他了解停电给受影响四个地区的家庭和企业造成的压力。特格比说，他的团队正分阶段努力恢复受影响发电机组的运行，从昨天起算，首批机组预计将在48至72小时内重新上线。他说，部长还在与运营商合作，以改善天然气供应并加快受损基础设施的维修。特格比还赞扬了受影响各州居民的耐心等待。“我感谢所有受影响人士的耐心，并将在供应逐步恢复后提供进一步通报，”他表示。目前持续数日的停电已波及这四个州，许多家庭和企业长时间陷入黑暗，被迫依赖替代电源。在停电影响地区，各配电公司已宣布限电安排，许多A类客户抱怨供电时长大幅减少。部长早前表示，低水位导致水电站发电减少以及火力发电站面临天然气限制等因素，使情况更加复杂，这些因素限制了向配电公司输送的电量。与此同时，TCN否定了IKEDC将多条A类馈线停电归因于“电网不稳定”的说法。TCN昨天发布声明称，这家输电公司表示，IKEDC在11月5日公开通知中作出的归因“不准确且具有误导性”。TCN称，根据《2023年电力法》第67条，确定全国电网干扰、供应短缺和停电根本原因的工作，完全属于尼日利亚独立系统运营商（NISO）的既定职能。“IKEDC与其他所有市场参与者一样，无权作出此类判断；NISO也未作出任何将IKEDC通知所列停电归因于TCN的决定，”它说。公司表示，NISO已在11月5日的公开声明中澄清有关情况，将当前发电量下降归因于向火力发电站供应天然气所受的限制，以及水库入水量减少导致水电站出力下降。据TCN称，NISO解释道，这一情况减少了可用发电量，进而减少了分配给各配电公司的电量，并导致供电时间缩短和各配电网限电增加。“IKEDC客户供应不足是发电量减少及其相应分配结果所致，并非TCN输电网络发生任何故障。TCN只能输送提供给它的电能，无法输送未生成的电能，”它说。TCN表示，为IKEDC供电的所有馈线记录均证实了NISO所描述的情况。11月1日和2日记录的停电中，68%是因发电量低而实施的频率控制限电，26%是由于IKEDC未遵守NISO国家控制中心（NCC）的负荷分配，或因IKEDC自身网络发生故障和施工，剩余6%则是TCN的计划检修、线路切换或线路容量限制。“记录的停电中没有一次源于TCN设备故障或跳闸，”它补充说。在IKEDC通知中列明的33千伏馈线上记录的46次停电中，TCN表示，29次是因发电量低而实施的频率控制限电，14次记在IKEDC名下，其中9次因不遵守负荷分配，5次因其自身网络故障或跳闸。据TCN称，另外3次停电计划于11月1日对Ogba-Alimosho线路进行维护。TCN敦促IKEDC及其他配电公司“立即停止就向客户供应短缺的原因作出毫无根据的说法”，并表示，此类说法会误导客户、削弱公众信心，并掩盖有关利益相关方需要解决的实际难题。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创刊，由THISDAY
