Oshiomhole made the statement during an interview on Channels Television’s Politics Today on Thursday, where he defended the Tinubu administration’s performance and urged Nigerians to appreciate its policies.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinu.summary_zh: 代表埃多州北区的参议员亚当斯·奥肖莫霍勒表示，联邦政府批准每月发放₦70,000交通津贴，体现出总统博拉·蒂努布对劳动者福祉的关切。奥肖莫霍勒周四接受《Channels Television》的《今日政治》节目采访时发表上述言论，并为蒂努布政府的施政表现辩护，同时敦促尼日利亚人珍惜政府的各项政策。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinu.body: Senator representing Edo North, Adams Oshiomhole, has said President Bola Tinubu has demonstrated concern for workers’ welfare through the Federal Government’s approval of a ₦70,000 monthly transport allowance. Oshiomhole made the statement during an interview on Channels Television’s Politics Today on Thursday, where he defended the Tinubu administration’s performance and urged Nigerians to appreciate its policies. “I think this government is doing well. If a man who was on ₦70,000 now is given ₦70,000 addition that makes it ₦140,000 for him it’s a hundred percent increase and if you know what ₦10,000 means for the real masses, you’ll appreciate that Tinubu has shown that he cares,” he said. The Federal Government approved the monthly ₦70,000 transport intervention for workers across all levels for six months, beginning in November 2026, following a meeting with the Nigeria Labour Congress (NLC) on October 27. The agreement also provides for the payment of outstanding peculiar allowances in three equal monthly instalments beginning in November. However, the Trade Union Congress (TUC) rejected the transport allowance, insisting that workers need a permanent salary increase rather than temporary relief. Oshiomhole also criticised the administration of former President Olusegun Obasanjo, under which Atiku Abubakar served as vice-president, alleging that it failed to guarantee the payment of workers’ salaries. He said the 2027 presidential election would offer Nigerians a choice between Tinubu, whom he credited with unifying the exchange rate, and Atiku, whom he accused of allowing multiple exchange rates that favoured people based on their connections. The senator also faulted the presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), Peter Obi, for allegedly failing to present an alternative to Tinubu’s policies. “Peter Obi has not offered any alternative. I’ve always said that Peter Obi is a trader; the logic of a trader is short term turnover. A statesman that Tinubu represents thinks of the next generation,” Oshiomhole said. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinu.title_zh: 蒂努布以₦70,000津贴表明自己关心工人
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/tinu.body_zh: 代表埃多州北区的参议员亚当斯·奥希奥莫霍尔表示，联邦政府批准每月向劳动者发放₦70,000交通补贴，说明总统博拉·蒂努布切实关注劳动者福祉。奥希奥莫霍尔周四在Channels Television的《今日政治》节目中接受采访时作出上述表态。他为蒂努布政府的表现辩护，并敦促尼日利亚民众 appreciate 其政策。他说：“我认为本届政府表现良好。如果一个人原本领取₦70,000，如今又获得₦70,000，那么他的收入就是₦140,000，增幅达到100%。如果你明白₦10,000对普通民众意味着什么，你就会体会到蒂努布确实表示了关切。”联邦政府在10月27日与尼日利亚劳工大会（NLC）会晤后，批准从2026年11月起，为各级劳动者提供为期六个月的每月₦70,000交通补贴。协议还规定，从11月开始，分三个月的等额 installments 支付拖欠的特殊津贴。然而，尼日利亚工会大会（TUC）拒绝接受交通补贴方案，坚持认为劳动者需要永久性加薪，而不是临时救济。奥希奥莫霍尔还批评了奥卢塞贡·奥巴桑乔前总统执政时期，指出阿蒂库·阿布巴卡尔曾任该政府副总统，并声称政府未能确保按时支付劳动者工资。他说，2027年总统选举将让尼日利亚民众在蒂努布和阿蒂库之间作出选择；他认为蒂努布实现了统一汇率，而阿蒂库则纵容多种汇率并存，使有关系的人从中受益。这位参议员还指责尼日利亚民主党（NDC）总统候选人彼得·奥比，称其未能提出取代蒂努布政策的替代方案。奥希奥莫霍尔说：“彼得·奥比没有提出任何替代方案。我一直说彼得·奥比是个商人；商人的逻辑是短期周转。蒂努布所代表的是政治家式的思维，他会考虑下一代。”奥希奥莫霍尔说。本文所表达的观点不代表Vanguard newspapers及其任何员工的意见

https://leadership.ng/from-the-strait-of.title: From The Strait Of Hormuz To The Strait Of Midterm, Trump Pays Heavy Price
https://leadership.ng/from-the-strait-of.summary: The midterm results just re-echoed Stoken’s point that the pendulum of US politics swings toward the middle all the time, not despite the voters, but because of them. But because the Democratic Party had lost its way by creating a nanny state, compounding red tape, and deifying wokeism, Trump’s idiosyncrasies looked like middle ground. It remains to be seen if, finally, the midterm has taught the Trump White House the lesson that it failed to learn from turning the world on its head.
https://leadership.ng/from-the-strait-of.summary_zh: 中期选举结果再次印证了斯托肯的观点：美国政治的钟摆始终朝向中间路线，不是因为选民而偏离中间路线，而是正因为选民才会如此。然而，由于民主党通过建立保姆型国家、层层增加繁文缛节并将 wokeism 奉为圭臬而迷失方向，特朗普的特立独行看起来便像是中间路线。仍待观察的是，中期选举是否终于让特朗普白宫吸取教训，而这一教训它此前在试图颠覆世界时未能学会。
https://leadership.ng/from-the-strait-of.body: The midterm results just re-echoed Stoken’s point that the pendulum of US politics swings toward the middle all the time, not despite the voters, but because of them. One Trump term (2017-2021) was enough. But because the Democratic Party had lost its way by creating a nanny state, compounding red tape, and deifying wokeism, Trump’s idiosyncrasies looked like middle ground. He was voted in again in 2024, despite his hubris. Two years later, the pendulum is swinging left again. It’s funny that a president who dragged the US into a needless Middle East war with serious economic consequences for the world, sparked global tariff wars, criminalised migration, and bullied neighbours and allies alike is unable to save his party from electoral ruin. Voters have just reminded him that all 45 presidents who have occupied the White House since 1776 are tenants, not owner-occupiers. If it were up to him, Trump would have stuffed the ballots, created a crisis, or manufactured any subterfuge to change the results. But despite his disdain for process, his vindictive narrow-mindedness and desperation for vengeance, he could not. Despairing voters tamed him on November 3. Americans, or at least a significant number of them, have delivered the first nationwide verdict on Trump’s second term. Midterms are not a presidential election, but this one almost assumed the character of one – with President Barack Obama and Trump himself hitting the road and mounting the soapbox. The outcome is a Democratic breakthrough that feels like a landslide. All 435 seats in the House of Representatives were on the ballot, along with 35 of the 100 Senate seats and 36 governorships. The stakes were straightforward: Republicans controlled both chambers of Congress. Following the polls, Democrats flipped the hitherto red Congress to blue. The contest itself was not merely between two parties. It was between two versions of America – one energised by Trump’s MAGA delusions; the other alarmed by the cost of living, Trump’s misuse and abuse of power, and the slow unravelling of the American dream. As an unwritten rule, midterm elections often punish the president’s party. Voters, having handed a president the keys to the White House, return two years later to endorse or denounce the state of affairs. And since Trump-2 happened, the state of affairs has been not just perilous but life-threatening. With Americans being shot on the streets by ICE agents in what is clearly state-sanctioned murder, and vindictive attacks on critics like Ilhan Omar, the election assumed unusual urgency. Trump himself led the Republican campaigns, asking voters to assume he was on the ballot. That was a clear indication that, despite his incorrigibility, he was troubled by a likely unfavourable verdict – which is what he got. He told Americans to pretend he was on the ballot (he recanted after the devastating defeat), and offered a generous $5,000 bribe for every vote if Republicans won. His oligarch, Elon Musk, reportedly spent $474 million. Yet, Trump was punished, and Republicans lost. His approval rating has been near record lows, with public dissatisfaction focused on the economy and a foolish war in Iran, which a Republican Congress never felt any urgency about but felt helpless to stop. The election results are proof that Trump has been a liability and a political misadventure at the White House, as Republican candidates struggled to distance themselves from a president who demands loyalty and rarely admits error. They were still Trump enablers, and their loss should not be mourned. For Democrats, the election has been a breath of fresh air, and an opportunity to rebuild and regain institutional leverage. Theirs is broader than opposition to Trump. They campaigned on affordability – housing, prices, healthcare, and energy – while presenting themselves as the party prepared to check executive excesses. Their challenge was to turn anger into a governing argument, not merely a protest vote. The parties were not evenly matched in mood. Polling and early voting data indicated strong Democratic enthusiasm. Compared with Republicans, Democrats seemed far more motivated to vote, a sign that opposition to Trump brought infrequent voters to the polls – something party leaders had not succeeded at. Moreover, Trump’s claims on the economy, as with every other claim, became contested territory. Bloomberg reported that his handling of the economy, alongside the war in Iran, contributed to his very low approval ratings. Immigration was another defining issue. For Trump’s base, border enforcement is a promise kept. For Democrats and many independents, the obvious fact is that enforcement has become murderous, indiscriminate, divisive and damaging to America’s image. For young, minority and urban voters, immigration is a moral and civil-rights question. Foreign policy was another layer. The war in Iran has turned national security from a Republican talking point into a subject of scrutiny. Voters may support a strong military, but they also ask what a war would cost, who would fight it, and whether it would make everyday life safer. Americans showed up even with protest votes. Early voting data showed that roughly 54 million Americans had already cast ballots before election day. Of those, about 43 per cent were Democrats, 32 per cent were Republicans, and 25 per cent were independents or unaffiliated voters. More striking is the reported increase in turnout among voters of colour in the states that release race and ethnicity data. That matters because Democrats made gains among young, non-white and previously disengaged voters – groups that traditionally turn out at lower rates in midterms. The election was not decided in California or New York, where outcomes are largely predictable. It was decided in a handful of competitive states and districts: North Carolina, Georgia, Maine, Michigan, Texas, Ohio and Alaska were among the key battlegrounds. Now with Democrats in control of Congress, Trump’s final two years could change. For example, the Democratic Congress can investigate administration decisions, subpoena officials, scrutinise spending, examine the conduct of the war in Iran, and challenge policies on immigration, healthcare and the economy. The days of a rubber-stamp Congress may be well and truly over, and tougher scrutiny may be expected. Yet, while winning Congress gives Democrats substantial power to investigate, block new legislation and bargain over funding, it does not necessarily give them the votes to dismantle Trump’s existing legislative programmes while he remains president. Controversial Trump-signed laws, such as the tax-and-spending law in 2025 (the so-called One Big Beautiful Bill), the mandatory immigration detention for certain non-citizens charged with specified offences (the Laken Riley Act 2025), and federal judicial appointments, will be harder to reverse than imagined. Underestimate a demagogue at your peril. Trump may well rule America for the rest of his term by veto and Executive Orders, without Congress. It remains to be seen if, finally, the midterm has taught the Trump White House the lesson that it failed to learn from turning the world on its head. The pendulum is swinging back to the middle, but it’s still early days to be excited. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/from-the-strait-of.title_zh: 从霍尔木兹海峡到中期选举海峡，特朗普付出沉重代价
https://leadership.ng/from-the-strait-of.body_zh: 中期选举结果再次印证了斯托肯的观点：美国政治的钟摆始终在向中间摆动，这并非违背选民的意愿，而是因为选民才使它如此。特朗普的一届任期（2017—2021年）已经足以说明问题。但民主党通过打造保姆国家、层层叠加繁文缛节并将 wokenism 奉为圭臬而迷失方向后，特朗普的特立独行反倒显得像是中间路线。尽管他傲慢自负，他仍在2024年再次当选。两年后，钟摆又开始向左摆动。颇有意思的是，这位把美国拖入一场毫无必要的中东战争、给世界经济造成严重后果，挑起全球关税战，将移民刑事化，并欺凌邻国和盟国的总统，竟无法挽救自己的政党免遭选举惨败。选民刚刚提醒他，自1776年以来入主白宫的45位总统都是房客，而不是自有自住的业主。如果由他做主，特朗普会往选票箱里塞东西、制造危机，或编造任何花招来改变结果。然而，尽管他蔑视程序、心怀报复且狭隘偏执、急于雪耻，最终还是无法得逞。11月3日，绝望的选民制服了他。美国人，或者至少相当一部分美国人，已经就特朗普第二任期作出首次全国性裁决。中期选举并非总统选举，但这一次几乎具有总统选举的性质——总统巴拉克·奥巴马和特朗普本人亲自巡回各州站台造势。结果是一场民主党大突破，颇似压倒性胜利。众议院全部435个席位、参议院100个席位中的35席以及36个州长职位均接受选举。利害关系很简单：共和党此前控制国会两院。计票结束后，民主党把原本属于共和党的国会翻转为蓝色。这场较量不只是两党之间的竞争，也是两个版本的美国之间的较量——一个被特朗普的“MAGA”迷思所激励，另一个则对生活成本、特朗普滥用和滥用权力，以及美国梦缓慢瓦解深感不安。按照一条不成文的规则，中期选举往往会惩罚总统所属政党。选民把白宫钥匙交给总统后，两年后便会回来肯定或谴责现状。自特朗普第二任期开启以来，局势不仅危险，更攸关生死。美国人在街头被美国移民与海关执法局（ICE）特工枪击，这显然是国家纵容的谋杀；对伊尔汗·奥马尔等批评者的报复性攻击也令此次选举具有异乎寻常的紧迫性。特朗普亲自领衔共和党的竞选活动，要求选民假定他本人也在选票上。这清楚表明，尽管他桀骜难驯，却因可能遭受不利裁决而不安——而他确实遭遇了这一裁决。他告诉美国人假装自己就在选票上（遭遇惨败后他改口否认），并承诺若共和党获胜，每张选票将获得慷慨的5,000美元贿赂。据报道，他的寡头盟友埃隆·马斯克投入了4.74亿美元。然而，特朗普仍受到惩罚，共和党败选。他的支持率接近历史低点，公众的不满集中于经济以及在伊朗打的那场愚蠢战争。共和党国会从未觉得有紧迫感去处理这场战争，却又束手无策地无法阻止。选举结果证明，特朗普一直是白宫的负担和一次政治误判，因为共和党候选人竭力与这位要求忠诚、极少认错的总统划清界限。他们仍是特朗普的帮凶，他们的失败不值得哀悼。对民主党而言，这次选举令人耳目一新，也提供了重建并重获制度影响力的机会。民主党的立场远不只是反对特朗普。他们围绕生活可负担性展开竞选——住房、物价、医疗和能源——同时把自己塑造成准备制衡行政权力越界的政党。他们面临的挑战，是把愤怒转化为治国理据，而不只是投一张抗议票。两党的情绪基础并不同等。民调和提前投票数据显示，民主党热情高涨。与共和党相比，民主党选民似乎更有投票动力，这表明反对特朗普促使那些不常投票的人走进投票站，而这是党内领导人此前未能做到的。此外，特朗普对经济的说法，和他的其他所有说法一样，也成为争议地带。彭博社报道称，他对经济的处理以及伊朗战争共同导致了他的支持率极低。移民是另一个决定性议题。对特朗普的基本盘而言，边境执法是已经兑现的承诺。对民主党和许多独立选民而言，显而易见的事实是，执法已经变得杀戮化、缺乏选择性、具有分裂性，并损害了美国形象。对年轻选民、少数族裔选民和城市选民而言，移民是道德和公民权利问题。外交政策是另一层因素。伊朗战争已把国家安全从共和党的宣传口号变成受审视的议题。选民或许支持强大的军队，但也会追问战争要付出什么代价、谁来参战，以及它能否让日常生活更安全。美国人即使投的是抗议票，也出来投票了。提前投票数据显示，约有5,400万美国人在选举日之前已经投票。其中，约43%是民主党人，32%是共和党人，25%是独立选民或无党派选民。更引人注目的是，据报道，在公布种族和族裔数据的州，有色人种选民的投票率有所上升。这一点很重要，因为民主党在年轻选民、非白人选民和此前政治疏离选民中取得了进展，而这些群体在中选举中的传统投票率较低。决定此次选举胜负的并非结果大体可预测的加利福尼亚州或纽约州，而是少数竞争激烈的州和选区：北卡罗来纳州、佐治亚州、缅因州、密歇根州、得克萨斯州、俄亥俄州和阿拉斯加州均属关键战场。如今民主党掌控国会，特朗普最后两年的处境可能会改变。例如，民主党国会可以调查政府的决策、传唤官员、审查开支、检查伊朗战争的行为，并挑战移民、医疗和经济方面的政策。橡皮图章式国会的日子或许真的结束了，更严格的监督可以预期。然而，赢得国会虽然赋予民主党相当大的权力，可以展开调查、阻止新立法并围绕拨款进行谈判，却不一定会让他们在特朗普仍是总统时获得足够的票数来推翻他现有的立法计划。由特朗普签署的争议性法律，例如2025年的税收与支出法（所谓《一项宏大而美好的法案》）、对被控犯有特定罪行的某些非公民实行强制拘留的《莱肯·赖利法案2025》，以及联邦司法任命，推翻难度将超出人们的想象。低估煽动者必然后悔。特朗普完全可能凭借否决权和行政命令，在没有国会的情况下继续主导美国余下的任期。中期选举是否终于教会了特朗普白宫从把世界掀翻这件事中未能吸取的教训，仍有待观察。钟摆正在摆回中间，但现在还远不到兴奋的时候。我们占了上风。获取实时报道、突发独家新闻和独家视角，直接送达你的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入 https://dailytrust.com/muslim-candidates.body: Muslim candidates made history in Tuesday’s US midterm elections, winning seats in Congress and state legislatures despite a campaign marked by a surge in anti-Muslim rhetoric and attacks targeting their communities. The results included the election of America’s first Muslim senator, an Egyptian-American surgeon who treated wounded Palestinians in Gaza, and several Palestinian-American candidates. The victories came after President Donald Trump and his allies targeted Muslim candidates, particularly Michigan’s Abdul El-Sayed, who faced baseless allegations linking him to extremist groups. At least seven Muslim candidates were elected to Congress, including one senator and six House representatives. Egyptian-American Democrat Abdul El-Sayed, 42, defeated Republican Mike Rogers in Michigan to become the first Muslim elected to the US Senate. A physician and public health specialist, El-Sayed campaigned on healthcare, living costs and reducing corporate influence in politics. He also criticised US military assistance to Israel and Egypt, while rejecting accusations of Muslim Brotherhood links made by political opponents. Egyptian-American surgeon Adam Hamawy defeated Republican Greg Mele in New Jersey’s 12th Congressional District, becoming the state’s first Muslim representative in Congress. A former US Army surgeon, Hamawy helped save the life of future senator Tammy Duckworth after her helicopter was shot down in Iraq in 2004. He later volunteered in Gaza, treating Palestinians wounded in Israeli attacks, including children with severe injuries. Rashida Tlaib: Palestinian-American congresswoman wins again Rashida Tlaib secured a fifth term representing Michigan’s 12th Congressional District. The Palestinian-American Democrat, one of the first two Muslim women elected to Congress in 2018, remains a prominent critic of Israel’s war on Gaza. The Somali-American Democrat, another of Congress’s first Muslim women, has repeatedly criticised US support for Israel and faced attacks from President Donald Trump. Darializa Avila Chevalier: First Latina Muslim congresswoman The 33-year-old Democrat, of Dominican heritage, was reported to have become the first Latina Muslim woman elected to Congress. She previously gained prominence through civil rights activism and pro-Palestinian protests. Two other Muslim Democrats secured re-election to the House. Andre Carson retained Indiana’s 7th District, which he has represented since 2008, while civil rights advocate Lateefah Simon won another term in California’s 12th District. Her family was displaced from Palestine in 1948, eventually settling in the United States. Kawas campaigned on affordable housing, healthcare, immigrant rights and opposition to US funding for Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza. Lebanese-American Democrat Abbas Alawieh was elected to Michigan’s 2nd State Senate District, covering Dearborn and surrounding communities. Alawieh helped establish the Uncommitted movement, which challenged former President Joe Biden’s support for Israel during the 2024 presidential election. Previously a state representative, Syed’s victory transferred the seat from Republican to Democratic control. Arab-American Republican Darin LaHood retained his Illinois congressional seat. LaHood, whose great-grandparents emigrated from Lebanon, has spoken proudly of his Lebanese heritage, saying: “I’m very proud of that heritage.” He also co-chairs the US-Lebanon Friendship Caucus and has worked to strengthen ties between Washington and Beirut. Several Palestinian-American candidates also secured victories in state legislative elections, including Iman Jodeh in Colorado’s 29th State Senate District and Ruwa Romman in Georgia’s 7th State Senate District. In Illinois, Palestinian-American Democrat Abdelnasser Rashid was projected to retain his state House seat. Other Muslim women reportedly elected included Zaynab Mohamed in Minnesota, Munira Abdullahi in Ohio, Maryam Khan in Connecticut and Madinah Wilson-Anton in Delaware. Pakistani-American lawmakers Salman Bhojani and Suleman Lalani also secured re-election in Texas, while Saud Anwar retained his Connecticut State Senate seat and Tarik Khan won another term in Pennsylvania’s House. https://dailytrust.com/muslim-candidates.title_zh: 穆斯林候选人在美国中期选举中创造历史
https://dailytrust.com/muslim-candidates.body_zh: 穆斯林候选人在周二的美国中期选举中创造了历史。尽管此次竞选充斥着反穆斯林言论激增以及针对其社区的袭击，他们仍在国会和州议会赢得了席位。选举结果包括美国首位穆斯林参议员的诞生，他是一名曾在加沙治疗受伤巴勒斯坦人的埃及裔美国外科医生，以及多名巴勒斯坦裔美国候选人的胜选。此前，总统唐纳德·特朗普及其盟友针对穆斯林候选人展开攻击，尤其是密歇根州的阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德，后者遭到毫无根据的指控，被声称与极端组织有关。至少有7名穆斯林候选人当选国会议员，其中包括1名参议员和6名众议员。42岁的埃及裔美国民主党人阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德在密歇根州击败共和党人迈克·罗杰斯，成为首位当选美国参议员的穆斯林。作为一名医生和公共卫生专家，埃尔-赛义德以医疗保健、生活成本以及减少企业影响政治为竞选主题。他还批评美国对以色列和埃及的军事援助，同时驳斥政治对手关于其与穆斯林兄弟会有关联的指控。埃及裔美国外科医生亚当·哈马维在新泽西州第12国会选区击败共和党人格雷格·梅莱，成为该州首位进入国会的穆斯林代表。作为一名前美国陆军外科医生，2004年未来参议员塔米·达科沃斯的直升机在伊拉克遭击落后，哈马维曾协助挽救她的生命。此后，他自愿前往加沙，治疗在以色列袭击中受伤的巴勒斯坦人，其中包括遭受严重伤害的儿童。拉希达·特莱布：巴勒斯坦裔美国女议员再次胜选拉希达·特莱布成功赢得第五个任期，继续代表密歇根州第12国会选区。这位巴勒斯坦裔美国民主党人是2018年首批当选国会的两名穆斯林女性之一，她仍是加沙战争的主要批评者。这名索马里裔美国民主党人是国会首批穆斯林女性之一，曾多次批评美国对以色列的支持，并遭到总统唐纳德·特朗普的攻击。达里亚利萨·阿维拉·谢瓦利耶：首位拉丁裔穆斯林女议员据报道，这名33岁的民主党人拥有多米尼加裔背景，成为首位当选国会的拉丁裔穆斯林女性。她此前因参与民权行动和声援巴勒斯坦示威而广受关注。另有两名穆斯林民主党人成功赢得众议员连任。安德烈·卡森守住了印第安纳州第7选区，他自2008年以来一直代表该选区；民权活动家Lateefah Simon则在加利福尼亚州第12选区再次赢得一个任期。她的家人在1948年被迫离开巴勒斯坦，后来最终在美国定居。卡瓦斯以可负担住房、医疗保健、移民权利以及反对美国资助以色列在加沙实施的种族灭绝战争为竞选主题。黎巴嫩裔美国民主党人阿巴斯·阿拉维赫当选密歇根州第2州参议院选区议员，该选区覆盖迪尔伯恩及周边社区。阿拉维赫曾协助建立“不承诺”运动，在2024年总统选举期间挑战前总统乔·拜登对以色列的支持。阿拉维赫此前担任州众议员，赛义德的胜选使该席位由共和党掌控转为民主党掌控。阿拉伯裔美国共和党人达林·拉胡德守住了他在伊利诺伊州的国会席位。拉胡德的曾祖父母来自黎巴嫩，他曾自豪地谈及自己的黎巴嫩血统，并表示：“我为这份血统深感自豪。”他还共同主持美国—黎巴嫩友好小组，并努力加强华盛顿与贝鲁特之间的联系。数名巴勒斯坦裔美国候选人也在州议会选举中获胜，包括科罗拉多州第29州参议院选区的伊曼·乔德和佐治亚州第7州参议院选区的鲁瓦·罗曼。在伊利诺伊州，巴勒斯坦裔美国民主党人阿卜杜勒-纳赛尔·拉希德预计将保住其州众议员席位。据报道，其他当选的穆斯林女性还包括明尼苏达州的泽纳布·穆罕默德、俄亥俄州的穆妮拉·阿卜杜拉希、康涅狄格州的玛丽亚姆·汗，以及特拉华州的马迪娜·威尔逊-安东尼。巴基斯坦裔美国议员萨尔曼·博贾尼和苏莱曼·拉拉尼也在得克萨斯州成功连任；绍德·阿马尔守住了康涅狄格州参议院席位，塔里克·汗则在宾夕法尼亚州众议院再次赢得一个任期。加入《每日信任》WhatsApp社群，快速获取身边新闻与动态

Unlock these with Subscription Several Indian-origin candidates too notched up victories as Democrats made significant gains in the US midterm elections, positioning themselves to wrest key Senate seats from Republicans, delivering a stinging rebuke to President Donald Trump. Indian-American candidates Suhas Subramanyam and Pia Dandiya won their seats in the US House of Representatives from Virginia and Florida, respectively. On the other hand, Republican Vivek Ramaswamy was defeated in the race to become Ohio’s next governor. Suhas Subramanyam, who served as an advisor to former president Barack Obama, has been re-elected as a member of the US House of Representatives. The 40-year-old won from Virginia’s 10th congressional district , polling over 61.5% of the vote against Republican Dave Beckwith, who managed to win 36.4 per cent of the ballots cast. A former high school principal, Pia Dandiya became the newest Indian-American to be elected to the US House , defeating Republican Casey Askar in Florida’s 22nd Congressional district. Dandiya bagged 51.9% of the votes, while her opponent Askar polled 49.1% of the votes. Trump favourite Indian-American Vivek Ramaswamy was defeated in Ohio’s gubernatorial race, the home state of Vice President J. D. Vance, by Democrat Amy Acton after a bitter campaign that left the Republican Party divided. Other Indian-American candidates are awaiting their results as vote counting is still under way. Democrat Nithya Raman, who was born in Keralam, is locked in a keen contest with her former boss Karen Bass for the post of Mayor of Los Angeles, the US’s second-largest city. Indian-American lawmakers Ro Khanna, Ami Bera, Pramila Jayapal are seeking re-election to the US House of Representatives, while fellow Democrat Amish Shah is in the fray in competitive races to make their debut as Congresspersons. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: SEATTLE — Democrats' sweeping victories in Tuesday's U.S. midterm elections brought relief to many Koreans frustrated with President Donald Trump, but that relief did not necessarily translate into support for the Democratic Party. That was how Bo Young Lee, a Korean American business executive, summed up the election results. "Ultimately, the results on Tuesday were a byproduct of citizens' frustration with the Trump administration, rising costs, and the attacks on democracy," Lee, an international speaker specializing in AI ethics and corporate diversity, told The Korea Times. Another Korean American voter, a 47-year-old Texas resident who has traditionally supported Republicans, said she crossed party lines for the first time in Tuesday's election. "I voted Democratic simply because I wanted anyone but the Republicans," she said, requesting anonymity. "It was the first time in my life I'd ever voted for a Democrat." Her decision came as Texas, long considered a Republican stronghold, delivered some of the election's biggest surprises. Democrats won the governorship and a U.S. Senate seat in the state for the first time in decades, marking a dramatic shift in a state that had consistently rejected Democratic candidates in statewide races. The Democratic victories dealt a major setback to Trump, giving the party control of both chambers of Congress and setting the stage for a divided government during the remaining two years of his presidency. Across Korean-language online communities, the results prompted everything from celebrations to expressions of disbelief and cautious optimism. "I've lived in the U.S. for 20 years, and this is the first time I've paid so much attention to a midterm election," one commenter wrote. "I thought America had no hope after Trump became president for a second time. Now I feel a little reassured. At least there will be some checks on Trump's unchecked power." Another commenter said the results brought tears, describing the comfort of realizing that many others shared the same frustrations. Yet the conversations also showed that opposition to Trump did not necessarily translate into support for Democrats. One California resident said they had traditionally voted Republican because of disagreements with Democratic policies but voted Democratic this time out of frustration with Trump. "I absolutely despise Trump, but I don't support Democrats either because I disagree with many of their policies," one person wrote. Much of the debate centered on everyday concerns rather than party loyalty. Some blamed Trump's tariffs and economic policies for worsening the cost of living. Others worried that Democratic policies would increase government spending and place greater burdens on middle-class families. Education also emerged as a contentious issue, particularly among parents discussing LGBTQ-related topics in schools. Some expressed concerns about what their children were being taught, while others pushed back against what they considered exaggerated fears. The contrasting views highlighted differing political views among Korean Americans, with some putting aside longstanding party loyalties to oppose Trump while others remained skeptical of Democratic policies. Lee said the results reflected broader dissatisfaction with the Trump administration, but warned that Democrats should not take their victories for granted. "The newly elected Democrats can't forget the frustration that swept them into office. If people don't see meaningful change within a short period, we may see different results in 2028," she said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 旅美韩国人欢迎民主党取得胜利，但对未来走向仍存疑虑
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 西雅图——民主党在周二举行的美国中期选举中取得压倒性胜利，这让许多对唐纳德·特朗普总统感到失望的韩国人如释重负，但这种宽慰未必转化为对民主党的支持。旅美韩裔企业高管Bo Young Lee正是这样总结此次选举结果的。李在接受《韩国时报》采访时说：“归根结底，周二的结果是公民对特朗普政府的不满、生活成本上涨以及针对民主制度的攻击共同造成的副产品。”李是一名专注于人工智能伦理和企业多元化的国际演讲者。另一名旅美韩裔选民是一名47岁的得克萨斯州居民，过去一直支持共和党；她说，周二这次选举是她首次跨党派投票。“我投票给民主党，只是因为除了共和党之外，我愿意支持任何人。”她表示，并要求匿名。“这是我有生以来第一次投票给民主党人。”她的决定出现在得克萨斯州出人意料的选举结果之中。长期以来，得克萨斯州一直被视为共和党的大本营，但在此次选举中，民主党数十年来首次赢得该州州长职位和一个美国联邦参议院席位，这在该州全州范围的选举中历来拒绝民主党候选人的背景下，标志着一场剧烈转变。民主党的胜利对特朗普构成重大打击，使该党掌控了国会两院，并为特朗普剩余两年任期内的分立政府局面铺路。在韩语网络社群中，选举结果引发了庆祝、难以置信和谨慎乐观等不同反应。一名评论者写道：“我在美国生活了20年，这是第一次如此关注中期选举。我原以为特朗普第二任期开始后，美国就毫无希望了。现在我感到稍微安心了一些。至少会对特朗普不受制约的权力形成一些制衡。”另一名评论者说，选举结果令她感动落泪，因为意识到许多人也怀着同样的不满。然而，讨论也表明，反特朗普并不一定会转化为支持民主党。一名加利福尼亚州居民说，由于与民主党政策存在分歧，他过去一直投票给共和党，但此次出于对特朗普的不满而投票给民主党。一人写道：“我非常厌恶特朗普，但也不支持民主党，因为他们许多政策都与我相左。”争论大多围绕日常生活问题，而非党派忠诚。一些人将生活成本恶化归咎于特朗普的关税和经济政策。另一些人担心，民主党的政策会增加政府支出，给中产家庭带来更沉重的负担。教育也成为一个有争议的话题，尤其是在讨论学校 LGBTQ相关议题的家长之中。一些人担忧孩子正在接受的教育内容，另一些人则反驳他们认为被夸大的恐惧。这些对立观点凸显了韩裔美国人之间不同的政治立场：一些人搁置长期以来的党派忠诚，以反对特朗普；另一些人则仍对民主党政策持怀疑态度。李表示，选举结果反映了人们对特朗普政府更广泛的不满，但警告民主党不应把胜利视为理所当然。她说：“新当选的民主党人不能忘记，正是这股不满情绪把他们推上了台。如果人们短期内看不到有意义的改变，那么2028年我们可能会看到不同的结果。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary: NEW YORK — Another wipeout for stocks tied to the buildout of AI data centers is overwhelming Wall Street on Thursday and more than erasing all its gains from the day before, which was its best in three months. It’s on track for its worst drop since President Donald Trump shook markets worldwide in April 2025 after announcing his “Liberation Day” tariffs. AI chip stocks are some of Wall Street’s most influential because they’ve become some of the largest.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 纽约——周四，与人工智能数据中心建设相关的股票再次遭遇大幅下挫，跌幅压倒华尔街，并抹去了该指数前一天的全部涨幅，而前一天是其三个月来表现最好的一天。自唐纳德·特朗普总统于2025年4月宣布“解放日”关税、震动全球市场以来，华尔街正有望录得自那以来的最严重跌幅。人工智能芯片股是华尔街最具影响力的股票类别之一，因为其中一些已经成为规模最大的股票。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: NEW YORK — Another wipeout for stocks tied to the buildout of AI data centers is overwhelming Wall Street on Thursday and more than erasing all its gains from the day before, which was its best in three months. The S&P 500 fell 3.2 percent after opening with a loss that accelerated through the morning. It’s on track for its worst drop since President Donald Trump shook markets worldwide in April 2025 after announcing his “Liberation Day” tariffs. The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 1,146 points, or 2.1 percent, as of 11 a.m. Eastern time, and the Nasdaq composite was 5 percent lower. Stock markets worldwide felt pressure from continued drops for companies that benefited from the boom for the artificial-intelligence technology industry, and South Korea’s Kospi index tumbled 5.3 percent. Such stocks have been swinging for months on worries that the construction of further AI data centers may slow because of how expensive it’s become to borrow money . Nvidia fell 8.3 percent and was by far the heaviest weight on the S&P 500, a day after dropping 3.2 percent. Advanced Micro Devices tumbled 15.9 percent. CoreWeave, a company that rents access to AI chips to customers over the cloud, fell 14.9 percent. GE Vernova, which has been helping to power data centers, sank 9.1 percent. AI chip stocks are some of Wall Street’s most influential because they’ve become some of the largest. A 1 percent move for Nvidia, for example, has more effect on the S&P 500 than a 1 percent move for nearly any other U.S. stock. Leading them was AppLovin, which soared 30.2 percent after the marketing platform reported both revenue and profit that topped analysts’ expectations. It also approved a program to send up to $3.2 billion to its investors by buying back its own stock, bringing the program’s total potential value to $3.6 billion. Tapestry rallied 6.7 percent after the company behind the Coach and Kate Spade brands likewise delivered a stronger profit than expected. It also raised its forecasts for revenue and earnings this fiscal year. Stock prices tend to follow where corporate profits and interest rates go over the long term, depending on them much more than on who controls what in Washington. In other financial markets, the initial knee-jerk reaction to the U.S. midterm election results faded a bit. The price of a barrel of Brent crude oil rose 2.2 percent to $96.70 and recovered a chunk of its nearly 9 percent drop from the day before. Uncertainty still reigns about what will happen in the war with Iran and when the global energy industry can return to normal. In the bond market, Treasury yields continued to ease. The yield on the 10-year Treasury fell to 4.84 percent from 4.90 percent late Wednesday. It had been at 4.95 percent on election night and above 5.30 percent last month. That could be a signal that investors are herding into U.S. Treasury bonds in search of something that’s safer to own than stocks. The drop also came despite some encouraging reports on the U.S. economy. Fewer U.S. workers applied for unemployment benefits last week. A separate report, meanwhile, suggested overall productivity for U.S. workers improved by more during the summer than economists expected. That could help the economy grow without adding pressure to the nation’s high inflation. In stock markets abroad, indexes were mixed in Europe and Asia. Besides South Korea, Japan’s Nikkei 225 also felt the sting of drops for tech and AI-related stocks and sank 1.8 percent. London’s FTSE 100 dipped 0.1 percent after the Bank of England increased its main interest rate for the first time in three years to help limit high inflation. The bank said its next moves on interest rates largely hinge on what happens with the Iran war , which sent oil prices and inflation higher worldwide. “We’ve seen encouraging news in the past 48 hours,” Bank Gov. Andrew Bailey said at a press briefing. “The best thing that can happen is to resolve the conflict in the Middle East; there’s no question about it.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 人工智能芯片股下挫，华尔街或迎来2025年特朗普宣布关税以来最糟糕的一天
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 纽约——周四，与人工智能数据中心建设相关的股票再次遭遇重挫，令华尔街承压，并抹去了前一日的全部涨幅，而前一日是该指数三个月以来的最佳表现。标普500指数低开3.2%，跌幅在上午进一步扩大，按目前走势将创自美国总统唐纳德·特朗普于2025年4月宣布“解放日”关税并震动全球市场以来的最大单日跌幅。截至美东时间上午11时，道琼斯工业平均指数下跌1,146点，跌幅为2.1%；纳斯达克综合指数下跌5%。在全球股票市场，受人工智能技术产业繁荣带动而受益的公司持续下跌，各市场均承受压力，韩国综合股价指数重挫5.3%。数月来，这类股票一直大幅波动，市场担忧，随着借贷成本变得十分昂贵，进一步建设人工智能数据中心的步伐可能放缓。Nvidia下跌8.3%，成为拖累标普500指数的最主要因素；此前一日，该股已下跌3.2%。Advanced Micro Devices重挫15.9%。CoreWeave通过云端向客户提供人工智能芯片使用服务，其股价下跌14.9%。为数据中心供电的GE Vernova暴跌9.1%。人工智能芯片股是华尔街影响力最大的股票之一，因为它们已成为市值最大的股票之一。例如，Nvidia股价每变动1%，对标普500指数的影响都超过美国其他几乎任何一只股票变动1%带来的影响。AppLovin领涨，在营销平台公布的营收和利润均超过分析师预期后，股价飙升30.2%。该平台还批准了一项最高向投资者支付32亿美元的股票回购计划，使该计划潜在总价值达到36亿美元。Tapestry上涨6.7%，此前这家Coach和Kate Spade品牌背后的公司同样公布了高于预期的利润，并上调了本财年的营收和盈利预测。长期来看，股票价格往往取决于企业利润和利率的走向，相比华盛顿由谁掌控，对这些因素的关注程度要高得多。在其他金融市场，美国中期选举结果公布后的初步本能反应已有所消退。每桶布伦特原油价格上涨2.2%，至96.70美元，收复了前一日近9%跌幅中的很大一部分。围绕对伊战争将如何发展以及全球能源行业何时能够恢复正常，不确定性仍然占据主导地位。在债券市场，美国国债收益率继续回落。10年期美国国债收益率从周三晚间的4.90%降至4.84%。选举之夜该收益率为4.95%，上月则高于5.30%。这或许表明，投资者正涌入美国国债，以寻找比股票更安全的持有资产。此次股市下跌还伴随着美国经济方面的一些鼓舞人心 reports。上周申请失业救济的美国工人减少。与此同时，另一份报告显示，美国劳动者的整体生产率在夏季的改善幅度超过经济学家预期。这可能有助于经济增长，同时不会给该国的高通胀带来额外压力。在海外股票市场，欧洲和亚洲各指数表现不一。除韩国外，日本日经225指数也受到科技和人工智能相关股票下跌的冲击，下跌1.8%。英格兰银行三年来首次提高主要利率，以帮助抑制高通胀，伦敦金融时报100指数随后下跌0.1%。该行表示，其下一步利率行动将在很大程度上取决于伊朗战争的发展，而这场战争已推高全球油价和通胀水平。英格兰银行行长Andrew Bailey在新闻发布会上说：“过去48小时，我们看到了一些令人鼓舞的消息。最好的结果是解决中东冲突；这一点毫无疑问。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — Korean American Rep. Dave Min (D-CA) of the U.S. Democratic Party won reelection to the U.S. House of Representatives, securing a second term in Congress, according to a race projection. The AP has called the race for Min over Republican Jenny Rae Le Roux in California's 47th congressional district as vote counting continued following Tuesday's midterm elections. With 62 percent of the vote counted, Min had secured 56.9 percent, leading Le Roux by 13.8 percentage points. Min, 50, was born in Rhode Island in 1976 to Korean immigrant parents. He graduated from the University of Pennsylvania and Harvard Law School before working as an enforcement attorney at the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. He later taught law at the University of California, Irvine, before entering politics. Min first ran for Congress in 2018 but finished third in the Democratic primary. He later won a seat in the California State Senate in 2020 and worked on legislation involving gun control and environmental protection. He made a successful second bid for the U.S. House in 2024, narrowly defeating Republican Scott Baugh in California's 47th district. Min became the third Korean American candidate win a congressional race in Tuesday's midterms, following Rep. Marilyn Strickland (D-WA) and Democratic Rep.-elect Dan Koh of Massachusetts. Strickland secured a fourth term, while Koh became the seventh Korean American elected to the U.S. Congress
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 韩裔美国众议员戴夫·明赢得美国众议院连任选举
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——据选举结果预测，美国民主党韩裔众议员戴夫·明（加州选区）成功连任美国众议院议员，将在国会获得第二个任期。周二中期选举后计票仍在进行之际，美联社已判定明在加利福尼亚州第47选区击败共和党人珍妮·雷·勒鲁克斯。已统计62%的选票时，明获得56.9%的支持率，领先勒鲁克斯13.8个百分点。50岁的明于1976年出生于罗得岛州，父母均为韩国移民。他毕业于宾夕法尼亚大学和哈佛法学院，之后曾在美国证券交易委员会担任执法律师，后来在加州大学尔湾分校教授法律，随后进入政界。明于2018年首次竞选国会议员，但在民主党初选中名列第三。2020年，他赢得加利福尼亚州参议院席位，并参与推动涉及枪支管控和环境保护的立法。2024年，他再次竞选美国众议员并成功连任，在加利福尼亚州第47选区以微弱优势击败共和党人斯科特·博。继华盛顿州众议员玛丽莲·斯特里克兰和马萨诸塞州候任民主党众议员丹·科之后，明成为周二中期选举中第三位赢得国会选举的韩裔美国候选人。斯特里克兰赢得第四个任期，科则成为当选美国国会议员的第七位韩裔美国人

Unlock these with Subscription The INDIA bloc on Thursday adopted a five-point resolution at its “Save the Vote, Save the Nation” protest at Freedom Park, demanding the scrapping of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the rejection of the revised electoral rolls in Karnataka. The declaration also urged the State government to conduct the forthcoming local body, taluk and zilla panchayat elections using the pre-SIR 2025 electoral rolls. It called for the repeal of the law governing the appointment of the Chief Election Commissioner and the restoration of an independent selection process in accordance with the Supreme Court’s directions. The resolution alleged that the names of more than 14 crore voters had been removed from electoral rolls nationwide. In Karnataka, the electorate had declined from 5.54 crore to approximately 4.5 crore in the final list published on October 27. Of the 99.32 lakh names removed, approximately 23 lakh pertained to deceased and duplicate voters, while nearly 76 lakh were alleged to be eligible voters, including migrants and those who had shifted residence. In Bengaluru, the number of voters has fallen from 1.04 crore to 59.08 lakh, with nearly 45 lakh names deleted, the declaration stated. It questioned the deletion of migrant voters and alleged that instead of updating their addresses through Form 8, they were being asked to apply afresh through Form 6. The resolution also alleged misuse of Form 7 applications by BJP workers to seek deletion of voters’ names and questioned the Election Commission of India’s (ECI) handling of such complaints. Addressing the gathering, Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar announced that the State government would initiate a police investigation into the alleged misuse of Form 7 applications. “There is CCTV footage showing who instigated vote theft and who brought the applications. Cases will be registered in this regard, and justice will be delivered,” he said. He alleged that Form 7 applications had been printed at the BJP office and circulated among constituency-level leaders along with voters’ names and identification details. He appealed to Booth Level Officers (BLOs) to cooperate in exposing the alleged irregularities. “Our principal demand is that the names of all voters deleted from the electoral rolls, except those who are deceased, must be restored,” he said, adding that the agitation would continue until justice was delivered to affected voters. Mr. Siddaramaiah said the large-scale reduction in Karnataka’s electorate raised serious concerns about the voting rights of eligible citizens. He demanded that the ECI disclose the reasons for the deletions and ensure that no eligible voter was excluded without due process. Questioning the changes to the selection process for election commissioners, he said the replacement of the Chief Justice of India with a Union Minister in the selection committee had raised concerns about the Election Commission’s independence. Karnataka Pradesh Congress Committee president B.K. Hariprasad said the protest was a continuation of the nationwide agitation held at Ramlila Maidan in New Delhi on November 1 under the leadership of Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge. “All political parties that believe in constitutional values and democratic institutions must unite,” he said. INDIA联盟周四在自由公园举行的“拯救选票，拯救国家”集会上通过了一项五点决议，要求取消选民名册特别集中修订（SIR）、首席选举专员Gyanesh Kumar辞职，并拒绝承认卡纳塔克邦修订后的选民名册。

声明还要求邦政府使用SIR实施前的2025年选民名册，举行即将到来的地方机构、塔卢克和县议会选举。决议呼吁废除有关首席选举专员任命的法律，并依照最高法院的指示恢复独立遴选程序。

决议称，全国范围内有超过1400万选民的姓名被从选民名册中删除。在卡纳塔克邦，最终名单于10月27日公布后，选民人数从5540万降至约450万。在被删除的993.2万个姓名中，约23万个属于已故选民和重复登记者，另有近76万个据称是符合条件的选民，包括外来务工人员和已经搬迁住所者。

声明称，在班加罗尔，选民人数从1040万降至590.8万，近450万个姓名被删除。声明质疑删除外来务工选民的合理性，并称他们本应通过第8号表格更新地址，却被要求通过第6号表格重新申请。

决议还称，BJP工作人员滥用第7号表格申请，以要求删除选民的姓名，并质疑印度选举委员会（ECI）对此类投诉的处理方式。

首席部长D.K. Shivakumar在集会上宣布，邦政府将就是否滥用第7号表格申请启动警方调查。他说：“有监控录像显示是谁煽动窃取选票、是谁提交了这些申请。我们将就此立案，并会伸张正义。”

他称，第7号表格申请是在BJP办公室打印的，并连同选民姓名和身份信息分发给各选区负责人。他呼吁投票站级官员（BLOs）配合揭露涉嫌违法不当的行为。

他说：“我们的主要要求是，除已故选民外，所有从选民名册中删除的选民姓名都必须恢复。”他补充说，在正义得到伸张、受影响选民的权益得到保障之前，抗议活动将持续进行。

Siddaramaiah先生表示，卡纳塔克邦选民人数大幅减少，引发了对符合资格的公民投票权的严重关切。他要求ECI公开删除选民姓名的原因，并确保任何符合条件的选民都不会在未经正当程序的情况下被排除在选民名册之外。

他质疑对选举专员遴选程序的改动，称在遴选委员会中由一名联邦部长取代印度首席大法官，引发了对选举委员会独立性的担忧。

卡纳塔克邦国大党委员会主席B.K. Hariprasad表示，这次抗议是11月1日在新德里Ramlila Maidan举行的全国性抗议活动的延续，该活动由Rahul Gandhi和Mallikarjun Kharge领导。

他说：“所有信奉宪法价值和民主制度的政党都必须团结起来。”他补充说，INDIA联盟将加强在卡纳塔克邦各地区的行动。

https://leadership.ng/agric-minister-to-.body: The Minister of Agriculture and Food Security, Abubakar Kyari is expected to lead other stakeholders at the opening of the 2026 National Agricultural Show scheduled to hold in November. The five-day event, organised by the National Agricultural Foundation of Nigeria (NAFN), will take place at the national agricultural showground in Nasarawa State. Kyari will attend as the special guest of Honour6 at the opening ceremony on Tuesday, November 17. In a statement, NAFN national coordinator, Aishatu Rufa’I Ibrahim, called on federal and state governments, local government authorities, private-sector operators, financial institutions, development partners and farmers to participate actively in the agricultural gathering. She said the annual show remained a major national platform for showcasing agricultural innovations, technologies, products, investment opportunities and practical solutions to challenges confronting Nigeria’s agricultural and food systems. According to her, this year’s edition is particularly important amid growing concerns over food security, rising production costs, climate change, limited access to finance, inadequate mechanisation and the need to strengthen agricultural value chains. She said the event would provide opportunities for stakeholders to exchange knowledge, establish strategic partnerships, explore investment opportunities and promote policies capable of transforming the agricultural sector. The NAFN coordinator urged federal and state ministries, departments and agencies , local government areas, organised private-sector organisations, financial institutions, research institutions, agribusiness investors, farmers’ associations, cooperatives, smallholder and commercial farmers to take advantage of the programme. She said government institutions would have opportunities to showcase their agricultural programmes, attract partnerships and identify practical interventions to advance rural development and food security. Ibrahim added that private-sector participants would benefit from networking, market access, business-to-business engagements and opportunities to invest across different agricultural value chains. For farmers, particularly smallholder producers, she said the show would provide exposure to improved technologies, modern farming practices, quality agricultural inputs, market linkages and opportunities to connect directly with service providers and potential buyers. The foundation said the show was designed to move stakeholders beyond discussions to practical collaborations and measurable outcomes that would strengthen Nigeria’s agrifood system. She said, “The annual national agricultural show remains a premier national platform for showcasing agricultural innovations, technologies, products, investment opportunities and practical solutions to the challenges confronting Nigeria’s agricultural and food systems. This year’s edition is particularly significant against the backdrop of growing concerns over food security, rising production costs, climate change, limited access to finance, inadequate mechanization and the need to strengthen agricultural value chains. “It will provide an opportunity for stakeholders to exchange knowledge, establish strategic partnerships, explore investment opportunities and promote policies that will transform Nigeria’s agricultural sector. NAFN believes that achieving sustainable food security requires collective action, strong public-private partnerships, increased investment and the adoption of innovative agricultural solutions. The national agricultural show provides a unique opportunity for all stakeholders to move beyond discussions to practical collaborations and measurable outcomes. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/agric-minister-to-.title_zh: 农业部长将主持开幕2026年农业展
https://leadership.ng/agric-minister-to-.body_zh: 尼日利亚农业与粮食安全部长阿布巴卡·基亚里预计将率其他利益相关方为2026年全国农业展揭幕，展览定于11月举行。这场为期五天的活动由尼日利亚国家农业基金会（NAFN）组织，将在纳萨拉瓦州国家农业展览场举行。基亚里将于11月17日星期二作为尊贵嘉宾出席开幕式。NAFN全国协调员艾莎图·鲁法伊·易卜拉欣在一份声明中呼吁联邦和州政府、地方政府当局、私营部门运营商、金融机构、发展伙伴及农民积极参与本次农业盛会。她说，年度展览仍是展示农业创新、技术、产品、投资机会以及应对尼日利亚农业和粮食体系所面临挑战的切实解决方案的重要全国平台。据她介绍，在人们日益关注粮食安全、生产成本上升、气候变化、融资渠道有限、机械化不足以及加强农业价值链需求的情况下，今年的展览尤其重要。她说，本次活动将为各利益相关方提供交流知识、建立战略伙伴关系、探索投资机会以及推动能够改变农业部门面貌的政策的机会。NAFN协调员敦促联邦和州各部委、司局和机构、地方政府辖区、有组织的私营部门组织、金融机构、研究机构、农业企业投资者、农民协会、合作社、小规模农户和商业农户充分利用本次项目。她说，政府机构将有机会展示其农业项目、吸引合作伙伴，并确定推进农村发展和粮食安全的切实干预措施。易卜拉欣补充称，私营部门参与者将从建立人脉、进入市场、企业对业务接洽以及投资不同农业价值链的机会中受益。对于农民，尤其是小规模生产者，她说，展览将使其接触改良技术、现代耕作方式、优质农业投入品、市场连接渠道，以及与服务提供商和潜在买家直接建立联系的机会。基金会表示，展览旨在推动各利益相关方超越讨论，开展切实合作并取得可衡量的成果，以加强尼日利亚的农业食品体系。她说：“全国年度农业展仍是展示农业创新、技术、产品、投资机会以及应对尼日利亚农业和粮食体系所面临挑战的切实解决方案的首要全国平台。在人们日益关注粮食安全、生产成本上升、气候变化、融资渠道有限、机械化不足以及加强农业价值链需求的情况下，今年的展览格外重要。“本次活动将为各利益相关方提供交流知识、建立战略伙伴关系、探索投资机会以及推动能够改变尼日利亚农业部门面貌的政策的机会。NAFN认为，实现可持续粮食安全需要集体行动、强有力的公私伙伴关系、加大投资以及采用创新农业解决方案。全国农业展为所有利益相关方提供了超越讨论、开展切实合作并取得可衡量成果的独特机会。我们掌握独家优势。订阅LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，即可在手机上直接获取实时报道、独家内幕和独家视角。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS，通过WhatsApp获取全天候最新动态 →

https://www.inquirer.net/494789/naga-cit.body: Comelec spokesperson John Rex Laudiangco said voter registration in Naga City would be temporarily suspended due to the November 21 plebiscite on its proposed conversion into a highly urbanized city. READ: Comelec to reopen voter registration on Nov. 10 for 2028 polls Meanwhile, Laudiangco said voter registration in six municipalities in Batanes would not reopen on November 10 due to the special elections scheduled on November 28 to fill a vacant seat in the House of Representatives. The six municipalities are Basco, Itbayat, Ivana, Mahatao, Sabtang, and Uyugan. Batanes lone district Rep. Ciriaco Gato Jr. died on September 21 due to cardiac arrest, leaving the congressional seat vacant. Laudiangco said registration would proceed in the rest of the country until July 30, 2027. READ: Comelec receives 4.7-M voter registration applications The Comelec will also bring its Special Register Anywhere Program to malls, airports, terminals, call centers, and universities to make voter registration more accessible. “Sa SRAP [Special Register Anywhere Program], doon magparehistro. Kami na po ang bahalang mag-publish ng pangalan ninyo, mag-aayos ng status ninyo at sisiguraduhin po namin, kung qualified po kayo, magiging registered voter kayo,” Laudiangco said. (Register through the SRAP. We will take care of publishing your name, updating your registration status and ensuring that you become a registered voter if you are qualified.) He also said that the poll body currently has around 69 million registered voters and expects the number to increase by 3 million during the eight-month registration period, bringing the total to between 71 million and 72 million. The figure differs from the 71 million registered voters earlier cited by Comelec Chairperson George Erwin Garcia in October. The poll body is also preparing to offer online reactivation services for voters whose registration records have been deactivated for failing to vote in two consecutive elections. Under the online reactivation system, applicants may access the application form through the Comelec’s iRehistro portal, fill in their personal information and generate a PDF copy of the application. The accomplished and signed form must then be submitted through email. Laudiangco also said the Comelec would schedule a video conference with applicants to verify their identities before deciding whether to approve their reactivation. “Magsasagawa lamang po tayo ng isang parang video conferencing. Magpapadala kayo via email ng form. At pag masiguro namin through the video conferencing na kayo nga ‘yan, eh yun na po yun,” he said. (We will simply conduct a video conference. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary: Time for Trump to transform his leadership The results of the U.S. midterm elections arrived earlier than expected here in Korea, and with a definitive outcome. As The New York Times wrote, "The system has held." Trump should heed the message his constituents have sent. South Korea must prepare for the possibility that Trump may bypass Seoul to engage with Pyongyang for his own political gain.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary_zh: 是时候让特朗普改变其领导方式了。美国中期选举结果比预期更早传回韩国，而且结果明确。正如《纽约时报》所言：“这个制度经受住了考验。”特朗普应当从选民传递的信息中汲取教训。韩国必须为特朗普可能绕过首尔，直接与平壤接触以谋取自身政治利益的可能性做好准备。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body: Time for Trump to transform his leadership The results of the U.S. midterm elections arrived earlier than expected here in Korea, and with a definitive outcome. The Democrats won control of Congress, seizing both the House and the Senate. The forecast for a "blue wave" changed to a "blue tsunami" in a matter of hours, according to U.S. reports, as voters signaled they wanted change. The Democrats' victory was widely viewed as a repudiation of U.S. President Donald Trump's nearly two years in office. South Koreans closely watched the race for the Senate, where the decisive powers to check presidential powers lay. Democratic candidates even won Senate races in the traditionally Republican states of Texas, Kansas and North and South Carolina. Media reports showed the electorate voting for change as they worried about the state of democracy and the economy, as rising prices stemming from Trump's war on Iran decreased the quality of life for the average U.S. constituent. An AP poll also found that most voters were concerned about government corruption, signaling a "strong desire for Congress to take a more forceful role in checking the presidency." Democrats will now have the authority to do so. Here in South Korea, the issues that drove the U.S. electorate to vote for change serve as a refreshing reminder that democratic values still matter . A nation that has long been identified with its political system and values seems like it's back. As The New York Times wrote, "The system has held." Trump should heed the message his constituents have sent. The American president initially said he accepted the election results, congratulating the Democrats for "doing a good job" and blaming Republican candidates for inadequate campaigning. Trump later posted on social media an image of a red cap with the word "veto," hinting that he would exercise his veto powers on the opposition-controlled Congress. It would be difficult to find another U.S. midterm election that allied nations watched as closely as this one. The second Trump administration has pursued some unprecedented policies in trade and foreign affairs. His aggressive tariffs on both allies and non-allies compelled Korea to pledge $350 billion in investments in the U.S. in exchange for a flat rate tariff of 15 percent. On security and foreign affairs, Trump has expressed his frustration at the scale of U.S. military deployment to South Korea, which he has repeatedly criticized for not participating in the Iran war as he had requested. Trump also reduced joint military drills this summer. He continues to maintain openness toward North Korea and its leader Kim Jong-un, providing a chance for dialogue as Pyongyang refuses to engage with Seoul. South Korea must prepare for the possibility that Trump may bypass Seoul to engage with Pyongyang for his own political gain. The election outcome is prompting concerns that Trump will expand his existing trade and diplomatic policies, putting allies on edge. While the Lee Jae Myung administration does not expect major changes in relations with the U.S. following the midterm elections, South Korea should still be vigilant in the last two years of Trump's presidency. Trump's remaining years in office will likely be an uphill battle as Democrats flex their powers of check and balance. The Democrats' cautious approach to artificial intelligence and data centers could weigh on Korea's semiconductor industry and chip rally. Their prudent stance on nuclear nonproliferation may also bode negatively for Seoul's nuclear submarine ambitions. Trump earlier said he approved South Korea's request to build a nuclear-powered submarine, following a summit last year between the two leaders in Gyeongju, North Gyeongsang Province. The transfer of wartime operational control may also run into challenges as Democrats generally uphold the traditional alliance. U.S. allies, including Korea, will have to prepare for heightened uncertainty from a frustrated president facing new limitations as the opposition party regains control of Congress. Korea should prepare with these factors in mind

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body_zh: 是时候让特朗普改变领导方式了。美国中期选举的结果比韩国媒体原先预计的更早出炉，而且结果明确。据美国媒体报道，数小时内，“蓝色浪潮”的预测就变成了“蓝色海啸”，选民表达了要求变革的意愿。民主党赢得国会控制权，同时拿下众议院和参议院。民主党在传统共和党占优的得克萨斯州、堪萨斯州以及北卡罗来纳州和南卡罗来纳州，甚至赢得了参议院选举。民主党在近两年执政期间受到广泛批评，被视为对特朗普总统执政表现的反证。韩国密切关注参议院选举，因为制衡总统权力的关键力量掌握在参议院。媒体报道显示，选民因担忧民主制度和经济状况而投票支持变革。特朗普对伊朗发动战争导致物价上涨，降低了普通美国公民的生活质量。美联社的一项民意调查还发现，多数选民担忧政府腐败，这表明选民“强烈希望国会采取更有力的行动制衡总统”。民主党如今将有权采取这种行动。在韩国，推动美国选民投票支持变革的种种问题令人耳目一新地提醒人们，民主价值观依然重要。这个长期以政治制度和价值观为民族特征的国家，似乎又找回了自身的方向。《纽约时报》写道：“这个制度经受住了考验。”特朗普应当从选民传递的信息中汲取教训。特朗普总统起初表示接受选举结果，祝贺民主党“干得不错”，并把竞选不力归咎于共和党候选人。后来，他在社交媒体上发布了一顶印有“否决权”字样的红色帽子，暗示他将对由反对党掌控的国会行使否决权。很难再找到另一场让盟国如此密切关注的美国中期选举。特朗普第二届政府推行了贸易和外交领域的一些前所未有政策。他对盟友和非盟友都加征强硬关税，迫使韩国承诺向美国投资3500亿美元，以换取15%的统一关税率。在安全和外交事务上，特朗普对美军在韩国的部署规模表示不满；他多次批评韩国没有按照他的要求参加对伊朗的战争。特朗普还削减了今年夏季的联合军演规模。他仍对朝鲜及其领导人金正恩持开放态度，在平壤拒绝与首尔接触的情况下，为对话提供了机会。韩国必须做好准备，因为特朗普可能绕开首尔，直接与平壤接触，以谋取自身政治利益。选举结果引发担忧，人们担心特朗普会扩大其现有贸易和外交政策，令盟国感到不安。尽管李在明政府预计中期选举后韩美关系不会发生重大变化，但在特朗普任期最后两年，韩国仍应保持警惕。随着民主党开始行使制衡权力，特朗普剩余的执政岁月很可能将是一场艰难鏖战。民主党对人工智能和数据中心持谨慎态度，可能对韩国半导体产业和芯片行情造成压力。他们在核不扩散问题上的审慎立场，也可能对首尔寻求核潜艇的努力产生不利影响。特朗普此前表示，在去年两位领导人于庆尚北道庆州举行峰会后，他已批准韩国建造核动力潜艇的请求。战时作战指挥权移交也可能遭遇挑战，因为民主党总体上支持传统盟国关系。包括韩国在内的美国盟国将不得不做好准备，应对一位因反对党重新掌控国会而面临新限制、并心怀不满的总统所带来的更大不确定性。韩国应考虑这些因素做好准备

"As both the Democratic and Republican parties have considered the alliance between the two countries important, I think there will not be very big changes in relations with South Korea," Han said during a parliamentary budget committee meeting after a lawmaker asked her to assess the election results. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 郑晚大：中期选举结果不太可能影响韩美同盟

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: “我们必须将华盛顿的立场与Coupang通过游说所获得的声量区分开来。”他认为，有关反美偏见的指控歪曲了韩国的执法记录，并可能将一起国内竞争法争端变成双边贸易问题。不过，Min argues华盛顿的这类担忧应结合Coupang在美国的游说活动来看，而不能直接视为韩国当局存在歧视性执法的证据。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: "Claims that Korea is discriminating against an American company are not based on the facts, and they are a narrative created by Coupang's lobbying in the United States,” Rep. Min Byoung-dug from the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) told The Korea Times during an interview on Thursday. "We must distinguish the position of Washington from the voice Coupang has bought through lobbying." He argued that allegations of anti-U.S. bias distort Korea’s enforcement record and risk turning a domestic competition law dispute into a bilateral trade issue. The second-term lawmaker urged the government to stand firm on the principle that companies operating in Korea must be subject to the same legal standards, regardless of where they are headquartered or listed. His comments offer a contrasting perspective to concerns expressed by the U.S. House Judiciary Committee. In July, the committee issued a report accusing the Korean government of discriminatory treatment against Coupang, and expressed concerns that authorities here slap excessive investigations and penalties on the U.S.-listed firm. The criticism came shortly after Korea’s Personal Information Protection Commission imposed a record 624.7 billion won ($451 million) fine on the e-commerce giant over a data breach incident last year. A U.S. lawmaker also recently introduced legislation that would block foreign officials’ entry into the U.S. when they are accused of using their influence to discriminate against American firms, citing the case of Coupang. The controversy further strained bilateral relations in October when U.S. visa applications by Rep. Jung Chung-rae of the DPK and the National Assembly’s National Defense Committee Chairman Jin Sung-joon had been delayed or denied. The issue fueled concerns that the dispute over Coupang could extend beyond corporate and regulatory matters and become a source of diplomatic friction between Seoul and Washington. Min, however, argued that such a concern from Washington should be viewed in the context of Coupang’s lobbying activities in the U.S., rather than accepted as evidence of discriminatory enforcement by Korean authorities. According to the lawmaker, Coupang Inc., the U.S.-listed parent firm of its Korean operating subsidiary, spent $10.75 million on lobbying during the five years that followed its U.S. stock market listing in 2021, while increasing the number of lobbyists working on its behalf from four to 32 during the period. Min also cited the company's hiring of a lobbying firm founded by an individual with longstanding ties to U.S. President Donald Trump, as well as disclosures concerning advisory fees that U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer received from Coupang before taking office. Greer received a $10,000 advisory fee from the e-commerce firm in May 2024 while serving as a partner at King & Spalding. At the heart of Min's argument is the claim that Korea applies competition laws according to corporate conduct, not nationality. He pointed to the Fair Trade Commission's 2020 decision to fine Naver 26.7 billion won over allegations that the country's largest internet portal manipulated its shopping and video search algorithms to favor its own services. Naver is Korea’s homegrown portal operator. Min said the case illustrates that domestic companies face equal regulatory scrutiny and can pursue the same legal remedies available to foreign companies. He also cited enforcement actions involving domestic platform giants, such as Baedal Minjok, saying the competition watchdog has confirmed that it applies the same standards to Korean and foreign businesses. He further argued that Korea's enforcement approach is consistent with the principles of U.S. competition policy. The U.S. has itself taken action against major technology companies over conduct involving market dominance, he noted. Min said a 2024 federal court ruling that Google illegally maintained a monopoly through anticompetitive conduct, as well as the Federal Trade Commission's antitrust case against Amazon, back up his argument. He also cited a $2.5 billion settlement involving Amazon over allegations of deceptive Prime subscription practices and barriers to cancellation. "It is difficult to argue that Korea is discriminating against an American company by regulating conduct that the U.S. itself treats as unlawful in its own market," he said. The lawmaker also stressed that Coupang's business is closely tied to Korea, regardless of its U.S. listing. The company directly employs about 87,000 people in Korea, while the overwhelming majority of its sales and consumer base are concentrated in the country. Applying Korean law to business activities conducted in the Korean market is consistent with international practice, Min said. A company's place of incorporation or stock market listing should not exempt it from the rules governing its operations. For the Korean government, the key is to prevent the dispute from becoming a bargaining chip in bilateral trade negotiations. "Law enforcement must be kept separate from trade negotiations," he said. "These measures cannot be exchanged for concessions in tariff negotiations or investment discussions. If the government backs down, the rule of law itself becomes a bargaining chip."
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: Coupang利用美国游说将韩国制裁描绘为歧视性措施
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 韩国执政党民主党（DPK）议员Min Byoung-dug周四接受《韩国时报》采访时表示，有关韩国歧视美国公司的说法并不符合事实，而是Coupang在美国进行游说所炮制的叙事。他说：“我们必须把华盛顿的立场与Coupang通过游说买来的声音区分开来。”他认为，指称执法偏向反美会歪曲韩国的执法记录，并可能把国内竞争法争端变成双边贸易问题。这位连任议员敦促政府坚持以下原则：无论企业总部设在哪里或在哪里上市，在韩国经营的企业都必须遵守相同的法律标准。他的言论与美国众议院司法委员会所表达的担忧形成了鲜明对照。今年7月，该委员会发布报告，指控韩国政府歧视性对待Coupang，并担忧韩国当局对这家在美上市企业施加过度调查和处罚。此前不久，韩国个人信息保护委员会因去年的数据泄露事件，对这家电商巨头处以创纪录的6247亿韩元（4.51亿美元）罚款。一名美国议员最近还提出一项法案，计划在外国官员被指控利用其影响力歧视美国企业时，禁止他们进入美国，并援引了Coupang的案例。10月，围绕Coupang的争议进一步加剧了韩美关系，当时民主党议员郑清 Rae以及韩国国会国防委员会主席Jin Sung-joon申请美国签证时遭到延迟或拒签。这一事件引发了人们的担忧：围绕Coupang的争端可能超出企业和监管事务范围，成为首尔与华盛顿之间的外交摩擦来源。然而，Min认为，华盛顿方面对此的担忧应结合Coupang在美国的游说活动来看待，而不应被当作韩国当局歧视性执法的证据。据这位议员称，Coupang Inc.是其在韩国运营子公司的美国上市母公司。该公司于2021年在美国股市上市，此后五年的游说支出达1075万美元，而在此期间代表其工作的说客人数也从4人增加到32人。Min还提到，该公司聘请了一家由一位与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普长期有联系的人士创立的游说公司；他还提到相关披露显示，美国贸易代表Jamieson Greer在上任前曾从Coupang收取咨询费。2024年5月，Greer以King & Spalding合伙人身份任职期间，从这家电商企业获得了1万美元咨询费。Min论点的核心是，韩国依据企业行为而非国籍适用竞争法。他指出，公平交易委员会于2020年作出决定，因有人指控韩国最大的互联网门户Naver操纵购物和视频搜索算法以优待自家服务，对该公司罚款267亿韩元。Naver是韩国本土门户运营商。Min表示，此案说明国内企业面临同等程度的监管审查，也可以寻求外国企业可用的相同法律救济。他还列举了涉及国内大型平台的执法行动，例如Baedal Minjok，并称竞争监管机构已经确认，对韩国企业和外国企业适用相同标准。他进一步主张，韩国的执法方式符合美国竞争政策的原则。他指出，美国自己也曾就涉及市场支配地位的行为对大型科技公司采取行动。Min表示，2024年一家联邦法院裁定Google通过反竞争行为非法维持垄断，以及联邦贸易委员会对Amazon提起的反垄断诉讼，都支持他的论点。他还提到，Amazon因被指控在Prime订阅实践中采取欺骗性做法并设置取消障碍，最终以25亿美元达成和解。他说：“美国自身就在本国市场将相关行为视为非法，因此很难说韩国通过监管这些行为而歧视美国企业。”这位议员还强调，无论Coupang是否在美国上市，其业务都与韩国密切相关。该公司在韩国直接雇用约8.7万人，其绝大部分销售额和消费者群体也都集中在韩国。Min表示，对在韩国市场开展的业务活动适用韩国法律，符合国际惯例。企业注册地或股票上市地点不应使其免于遵守经营所在地的规则。对韩国政府而言，关键是防止这一争端成为双边贸易谈判中的谈判筹码。他说：“执法必须与贸易谈判分开。这些措施不能被用来换取关税谈判或投资讨论中的让步。如果政府退让，法治本身就会成为谈判筹码。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: The government has not begun discussing sanctions on North Korea over its alleged theft of a massive amount of cryptocurrency, a unification ministry official said Thursday. "As of now, the government has not fully grasped the exact circumstances of the hacking case, so a discussion on how to respond to it has not even begun," the official told reporters at the government complex in Seoul. "Internal sharing and discussion inside the government are needed, but we have not reached that stage," the official added. Last week, the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) said North Korea was responsible for the theft of more than $6 billion in cryptocurrency from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange. Earlier this week, Kim Yo-jong, the powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, rejected the accusation, calling it a "grave political provocation" against the North. North Korea has been blamed for cyber thefts before and has consistently denied any involvement. The foreign ministry said that it is internally reviewing various measures, including unilateral sanctions against North Korea over its illicit cyber activities. "The government has made multifaceted efforts to counter North Korea's illicit cyber activities, including operating working groups with the United States and in a trilateral format with the United States and Japan," Park added. Separately, Unification Minister Chung Dong-young has opposed sanctions proposed against the North over the Sept. 21 land mine blast inside the Demilitarized Zone that wounded three South Korean soldiers, two of them seriously. Opposition parties have criticized him as being too lenient toward Pyongyang, while Chung has said such a measure would only provoke the North without producing any positive outcome
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 韩国统一部：尚未就朝鲜涉嫌通过Binance盗窃一事展开制裁磋商
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国统一部门官员周四表示，政府尚未开始讨论因朝鲜涉嫌盗窃巨额加密货币而对其实施制裁。“截至目前，政府尚未完全掌握这起黑客案件的具体情况，因此甚至还没有开始讨论应如何回应。”该官员在首尔政府综合办公大楼对记者说。“政府内部需要共享情况并进行讨论，但尚未进入这一阶段。”该官员补充道。上周，美国联邦调查局（FBI）表示，朝鲜应对从全球最大加密货币交易所币安盗走价值超过$6 billion的加密货币负责。本周早些时候，朝鲜领导人金正恩权势显赫的姐姐金与正否定了这一指控，称其是对朝鲜的“严重政治挑衅”。朝鲜此前曾被指责通过网络盗窃活动窃取财富，并一贯否认参与其中。外交部表示，正在内部审查包括针对朝鲜非法网络活动实施单边制裁在内的各种措施。朴补充说：“政府已采取多方面措施打击朝鲜的非法网络活动，包括与美国设立工作组，以及与美国、日本开展三方形式的合作。”此外，统一部长郑东永反对因9月21日非军事区地雷爆炸事件而对朝鲜实施制裁；该事件造成3名韩国士兵受伤，其中2人伤势严重。反对党批评他对平壤过于宽容，而郑则表示，此类措施只会激怒朝鲜，不会产生任何积极成果。

https://www.politico.eu/article/france-u.summary: The U.S. government has scuttled a French push for the G7 to coordinate on advanced AI safety, with a White House official calling it “unnecessary bureaucracy.” France’s digital minister Anne Le Hénanff told a French Senate hearing on Wednesday that she held two ministerial meetings in September and October to secure G7 commitments to a high-level working group to test frontier AI — the most advanced models — and share information about risks and incidents.
https://www.politico.eu/article/france-u.summary_zh: 美国政府挫败了法国推动七国集团协调先进人工智能安全工作的努力，一名白宫官员称此举是“不必要的官僚主义”。法国数字部长安妮·勒阿纳夫周三在法国参议院听证会上表示，她于9月和10月主持了两场部长级会议，以争取七国集团承诺成立一个高级别工作组，测试前沿人工智能——即最先进的模型——并分享有关风险和事件的信息。
https://www.politico.eu/article/france-u.body: The U.S. government has scuttled a French push for the G7 to coordinate on advanced AI safety, with a White House official calling it “unnecessary bureaucracy.” France’s digital minister Anne Le Hénanff told a French Senate hearing on Wednesday that she held two ministerial meetings in September and October to secure G7 commitments to a high-level working group to test frontier AI — the most advanced models — and share information about risks and incidents. That effort “did not reach a successful conclusion” because the U.S. wanted to pursue its own approach, the French minister said. “They are not prepared, at this stage, to issue a joint statement with the other six G7 nations, and have asked us to wait for the findings of their own assessment,” said Le Hénanff. “Naturally, we regret this, but we are continuing to move forward as Europeans on this issue.” The official pointed to U.S. President Donald Trump’s Super Intelligence Force, saying it brings government and industry together to accelerate innovation and ensure the safe deployment of models. France, which holds the rotating presidency of the G7 for 2026, issued a chair’s summary statement after the Oct. 20 virtual G7 tech ministerial, which noted that ministers considered closer coordination on identifying risks and sharing incident information, as well as a dedicated high-level group. It was not a joint statement endorsed by all G7 members. Trump began promoting “super intelligence” as a replacement for “artificial intelligence” at the U.N. General Assembly in late September. A week later, he ordered federal agencies to use the new term . G7 ministers in May agreed to discuss secure AI and risk assessment, which was followed by the G7 leaders meeting the following month in Évian. But the stakes have risen as advanced AI systems gain unprecedented cyber capabilities that can be used for both attack and defense. In July, Hugging Face disclosed an intrusion driven by an autonomous AI agent. OpenAI later said models used in an internal cybersecurity test had bypassed controls and compromised parts of its own research infrastructure and Hugging Face’s systems. Le Hénanff said France would keep pushing the issue, citing INESIA, France’s national AI evaluation and safety institute, and Inria, its public research institute for digital science and technology, as resources for the work
https://www.politico.eu/article/france-u.title_zh: 法国与美国就七国集团人工智能安全行动发生分歧
https://www.politico.eu/article/france-u.body_zh: 美国政府挫败了法国推动七国集团协调应对先进人工智能安全问题的努力，一名白宫官员称此举是“多余的官僚程序”。法国数字部长安妮·勒埃南夫周三在法国参议院听证会上表示，她于9月和10月主持了两次部长级会议，争取七国集团承诺成立一个高级别工作组，对前沿人工智能——即最先进的模型——进行测试，并共享风险和事故信息。这项努力“未能取得成功成果”，因为美国希望采取自己的方式，这位法国部长说。勒埃南夫说：“目前，他们还没有准备好与其他六个七国集团国家发表联合声明，并要求我们等待他们自己评估的结果。”“当然，我们对此感到遗憾，但作为欧洲人，我们仍会继续推进这个问题。”这名官员提到了美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的“超级情报力部队”，称其将政府与行业联合起来，以加快创新并确保模型安全部署。法国担任七国集团2026年轮值主席国，并在10月20日举行的七国集团虚拟科技部长级会议后发布主席总结声明，称部长们考虑加强协调，以识别风险和共享事故信息，并设立一个专门的高级别工作组。这并非七国集团全体成员共同批准的联合声明。9月下旬，特朗普在联合国大会上开始倡导以“超级智能”取代“人工智能”。一周后，他下令联邦机构使用这一新术语。5月，七国集团部长同意讨论安全人工智能和风险评估，随后七国集团领导人在翌于埃维昂举行的会议上讨论了这一问题。但随着先进人工智能系统获得前所未有的网络能力，可同时用于攻击和防御，问题的严重性不断上升。7月，Hugging Face披露了一次由自主人工智能代理实施的入侵。OpenAI后来表示，内部网络安全测试中使用的模型绕过控制措施，侵入了其自身部分研究基础设施以及Hugging Face的系统。勒埃南夫表示，法国将继续推动这一议题，并援引法国国家人工智能评估与安全研究所INESA，以及法国数字科学与技术公共研究机构Inria，作为开展这项工作的资源

Unlock these with Subscription The rupee settled on a flat note at 94.46 (provisional) against the U.S. dollar on Thursday (November 5, 2026), as the support from lower crude oil prices was negated by a firm greenback in overseas markets. Forex traders said the Indian rupee is showing signs of near-term stabilisation after recovering sharply against the U.S. dollar in previous sessions. A positive trend in domestic equities and softening of crude oil prices, however, cushioned the downside. At the interbank foreign exchange market, the rupee opened weak at 94.36 and fell further to a low of 94.57 in intraday trade. The unit recouped some losses in the closing session to settle at 94.46 (provisional), unchanged from its previous close. On Wednesday (November 5, 2026), the rupee stayed firm for the second straight session to settle 29 paise higher at 94.46 against the U.S. dollar. “The drivers favour the rupee: foreign portfolio inflows can pick up as India stands out from the AI unwind, political uncertainty in the U.S. can weigh on the dollar, and India’s import bill falls with every dollar off crude. The RBI’s calibrated management, with the repo rate at 5.50 per cent and reserves of about USD 720 billion, has kept the currency orderly through the worst of the oil shock and now gives it room to appreciate without disorder,” said Anindya Banerjee, Head of Commodity and Currency Research, Kotak NEO. Meanwhile, the dollar index, which gauges the greenback’s strength against a basket of six currencies, was trading at 101.50, lower by 0.06%. Brent crude, the global oil benchmark, was trading higher by 1.38% at $95.93 per barrel in futures trade. On the domestic equity market front, the Sensex jumped 2,008.61 points to end at 79,310.01, while the Nifty surged 576 points to 24,536.60. Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) remained net buyers on Wednesday (November 4, 2026), purchasing equities worth ₹7,284.03 crore, according to exchange data. 周四（2026年11月5日），卢比兑美元在94.46的暂定水平持平结算。原油价格下跌带来的支撑，被海外市场坚挺的美元抵消。外汇交易员表示，在此前几个交易日卢比兑美元大幅回升后，目前已显现出短期企稳迹象。不过，国内股市走强和原油价格回落缓冲了卢比的下行压力。

在银行间外汇市场，卢比以94.36的疲弱水平开盘，盘中进一步跌至94.57的低点。尾盘交易中，卢比收复部分跌幅，以94.46的暂定水平结算，与前收盘价持平。

周三（2026年11月5日），卢比连续第二个交易日保持坚挺，兑美元收高29派士，报94.46。

Kotak NEO大宗商品与货币研究主管Anindya Banerjee表示：“推动卢比走势的因素依然有利：在印度从人工智能去杠杆潮中脱颖而出之际，外国证券投资资金流入可能回升；美国的政治不确定性可能对美元构成压力；而原油每下跌一美元，印度的进口账单就会随之减少。印度储备银行采取有针对性的调控措施，在回购利率为5.50%、外汇储备约为7200亿美元的情况下，即便在油价冲击最严重的时候也维持了本币的有序运行，如今又为卢比有序升值留下了空间。”

与此同时，衡量美元兑六种货币篮子走势的美元指数报101.50，下跌0.06%。全球石油基准布伦特原油期货价格上涨1.38%，报每桶95.93美元。

在国内股市方面，Sensex指数上涨2,008.61点，收于79,310.01点；Nifty指数上涨576点，收于24,536.60点。

据交易所数据，周三（2026年11月4日），外国机构投资者（FIIs）继续净买入，购入价值₹7,284.03 crore的股票。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body: The Federal High Court in Abuja on Thursday sacked the leadership of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) under former Senate President David Mark and voided the party’s presidential ticket held by former Vice President Atiku Abubakar. Judge Peter Lifu said the “Mark-led Caretaker Committee, which conducted the party’s presidential primary that produced Atiku Abubakar as its flag bearer,” is illegal. The judge sacked the entire national officers of the party, including Rauf Aregbesola as the National Secretary, alongside all the candidates the party presented to the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) for the 2027 elections. The judgement, if upheld by the higher courts, means the ADC, a major challenger to the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC), is barred from fielding candidates in the upcoming general elections. The former ADC Deputy National Chairman, North-East, Nafiu Bala Gombe instituted the suit challenging the process through which Mr Mark and other members assumed the party’s leadership. On Thursday, the judge directed INEC not to recognise the decisions taken at the party’s 99th National Executive Committee meeting of 27 July 2025. The decision will be most likely challenged up to the level of the Supreme Court, which will give its final verdict before the general elections start in January. An appeal against the verdict will set off a return journey to the appellate courts, which initiallly gave an interim resolution with the Supreme Court restoring the Mr Mark leadership of the party in April. https://leadership.ng/association-endors.summary_zh: 他呼吁联邦政府建立支持性的法律和制度框架，以认可、保护并推动块塑产业持续发展。在开幕式后接受记者采访时，Adewale重申了协会支持Tinubu竞选第二个任期的决定，并表示会员们很荣幸有机会表达对总统的认同。
https://leadership.ng/association-endors.body: The group cites his administration’s efforts towards national development and economic growth. At the summit, NABMON national president, Alhaji Kareem Ayuba Adewale, said the group was proud to identify with the Tinubu administration and expressed confidence in its leadership. Adewale, however, drew the government’s attention to the challenges confronting block moulders across the country, particularly the rising cost of cement and other production materials, electricity, transportation, labour and machinery maintenance. He lamented that rising production costs were making it difficult for many block moulding businesses to remain competitive, sustain operations, and maintain quality standards. The NABMON president also identified inadequate contractor patronage and limited relationships between local block manufacturers and professionals in the construction industry as major challenges affecting the sector. He called on the Federal Government to establish a supportive legal and institutional framework that would recognise, protect and strengthen the block moulding industry. Adewale further appealed for greater government patronage of qualified local block manufacturers in public construction projects, stressing that compliant producers should be given opportunities to supply building materials for government-funded housing and infrastructure projects. He also called for accessible soft loans with low interest rates and reasonable repayment periods to enable members to acquire modern equipment, expand production capacity and employ more workers. He reaffirmed NABMON’s commitment to promoting professionalism, standardisation, quality production and responsible business practices among its members, while expressing readiness to collaborate with government agencies, cement manufacturers and professionals in the construction industry. In a goodwill message, the Director-General of the Standards Organisation of Nigeria (SON), Dr Ifeanyi Okeke, emphasised the strategic importance of block moulders in ensuring the safety, durability and sustainability of Nigeria’s built environment. Okeke, who acknowledged the importance of the sector, said SON remained committed to ensuring that products manufactured, distributed and consumed in Nigeria complied with applicable Nigerian Industrial Standards. He disclosed that the organisation had intensified efforts to combat the production and circulation of substandard and counterfeit products through factory inspections, market surveillance, product sampling and enforcement of regulations. The SON director-general stressed that compliance with relevant standards for concrete, cement and other construction materials was non-negotiable, warning that poor-quality building materials posed serious threats to structural integrity, public safety and national development. Okeke therefore urged NABMON members to embrace standardisation, ensure that their production processes met applicable specifications and submit their products for the necessary conformity assessments and certification. He also called for stronger collaboration between SON and the association through technical capacity building, laboratory testing, certification services and active participation in standards development. According to him, quality compliance should no longer be viewed merely as a regulatory requirement but as a shared responsibility and competitive advantage for Nigerian manufacturers. Speaking with journalists after the opening ceremony, Adewale reiterated the association’s decision to endorse Tinubu for a second term, saying members were pleased with the opportunity to identify with the President. On the association’s contribution to national development, Adewale maintained that block moulders played a critical role in the construction industry, arguing that blocks constituted a significant proportion of materials used in building projects across the country. He also expressed concern over disparities in cement prices across different parts of Nigeria, citing prices of about N13,500 per bag in some locations, including Lagos and Osun State, compared with approximately N11,700 in Abuja and N12,500 in Adamawa State. He called on the Federal Government to investigate the price discrepancies and intervene to address the rising costs of cement and other essential inputs for block production. The NABMON president also appealed for government assistance in accessing affordable financing to enable members to acquire machinery and other equipment needed to improve their businesses. The summit brought together government representatives, stakeholders in the building and construction industry, cement manufacturers, suppliers, contractors, architects, builders and engineers to deliberate on the contributions of block moulders to Nigeria’s economic and infrastructural development. The association expressed hope that the summit would produce practical resolutions to address the challenges facing the industry and strengthen its contribution to housing delivery, employment generation and national development. https://leadership.ng/association-endors.title_zh: 协会支持蒂努布竞选连任，并寻求为模塑行业争取支持
https://leadership.ng/association-endors.body_zh: 该组织赞扬他的政府为促进国家发展和经济增长所作的努力。在峰会期间，NABMON全国主席Alhaji Kareem Ayuba Adewale表示，该组织认同Tinubu政府，并对其领导力充满信心。然而，Adewale提请政府关注全国各地制砖企业面临的挑战，尤其是水泥及其他生产材料、电力、交通运输、人工和机械维护成本不断上涨的问题。他哀叹，生产成本上升正使许多制砖企业难以保持竞争力、维持运营并保持质量标准。NABMON全国主席还指出，承包商扶持不足，以及当地制砖商与建筑行业专业人士之间关系有限，是影响该行业的主要挑战。他呼吁联邦政府建立支持性的法律和制度框架，承认、保护并扶持制砖业。Adewale进一步呼吁政府加大力度扶持合格的当地制砖商参与公共建设项目，强调应为遵守规定生产商提供机会，使其能够为政府出资的住房和基础设施项目供应建筑材料。他还呼吁提供易于获取、利率较低且还款期限合理的优惠贷款，使会员能够购置现代设备、扩大产能并雇用更多工人。他重申NABMON致力于推动会员提高专业水平、落实标准化、确保生产质量并践行负责任的企业经营，同时表示愿意与政府机构、水泥制造商和建筑行业专业人士合作。在一项致意信息中，尼日利亚标准组织（SON）总干事Dr Ifeanyi Okeke强调，制砖商在保障尼日利亚建成环境的安全性、耐久性和可持续性方面具有战略重要性。Okeke承认该行业的重要性，并表示SON仍致力于确保在尼日利亚生产、分销和消费的产品符合适用的尼日利亚工业标准。他透露，该组织已加强打击不合格和假冒产品的生产与流通，通过工厂检查、市场监管、产品抽样和执行相关法规来开展工作。SON总干事强调，混凝土、水泥及其他建筑材料遵守相关标准是不可妥协的，并警告称，劣质建筑材料会对结构完整性、公共安全和国家发展构成严重威胁。因此，Okeke敦促NABMON会员接受标准化，确保其生产流程符合适用规范，并将产品提交进行必要的合格性评估和认证。他还呼吁通过技术能力建设、实验室检测、认证服务以及积极参与标准制定，加强SON与该协会之间的合作。据他表示，质量合规不应再仅仅被视为监管要求，而应被视为尼日利亚制造商的共同责任和竞争优势。开幕仪式后，Adewale在接受记者采访时重申，该协会决定再次支持Tinubu连任第二届任期，并表示会员很高兴有机会认同这位总统。在谈及该协会对国家发展的贡献时，Adewale坚持认为，制砖商在建筑行业中发挥着关键作用，并提出砌块占全国建筑项目所用材料的很大比例。他还担忧尼日利亚不同地区的水泥价格存在差异，并列举称，包括Lagos和Osun State在内的一些地区价格约为每袋N13,500，而Abuja约为N11,700，Adamawa State约为N12,500。他呼吁联邦政府调查价格差异，并采取干预措施，应对水泥及制砖所需其他重要投入品成本上涨的问题。NABMON全国主席还呼吁政府协助会员获得可负担的融资，以便购置改善业务所需的机械和其他设备。本次峰会汇聚了政府代表、建筑和建造行业利益相关者、水泥制造商、供应商、承包商、建筑师、施工人员和工程师，共同商讨制砖商对尼日利亚经济和基础设施发展的贡献。该协会希望峰会能够形成切实决议，解决该行业面临的挑战，并加强其对住房交付、就业创造和国家发展的贡献。我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、独家内幕和独家角度，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，随时获取全天候最新动态 →
